<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, interactive-widget=resizes-content">
<script id="dialog-shim">
(function(){
  var Q=[], busy=false, approved={}, ptxt={}, last=null;

  /* ghi lại thao tác thật của người dùng (click / change / chọn file) để chạy lại sau khi bấm Đồng ý */
  function cap(e){
    if(!e.isTrusted) return;
    var t=e.target; if(!t||!t.closest||t.closest('#__dlg')) return;
    approved={}; ptxt={};
    if(e.type==='change'){
      last={type:'change', el:t, value:t.value, checked:t.checked,
            files:(t.type==='file'&&t.files)?Array.prototype.slice.call(t.files):null};
    } else last={type:'click', el:t};
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',cap,true);
  document.addEventListener('change',cap,true);

  function replay(){
    var l=last; if(!l||!l.el||!l.el.isConnected) return;
    var el=l.el;
    if(l.type==='change'){
      if(l.files){
        try{ var dt=new DataTransfer(); l.files.forEach(function(f){dt.items.add(f);}); el.files=dt.files; }catch(x){}
      } else if(el.type==='checkbox'||el.type==='radio') el.checked=l.checked;
      else if('value' in el) el.value=l.value;
      el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));
    } else el.click();
  }

  function show(o){
    for(var i=0;i<Q.length;i++) if(Q[i].type===o.type&&Q[i].msg===o.msg) return;
    Q.push(o); if(!busy) next();
  }
  function next(){
    var o=Q.shift(); if(!o){busy=false;return;} busy=true;
    var ov=document.createElement('div'); ov.id='__dlg';
    ov.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;background:rgba(14,30,22,.6);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",Arial,sans-serif';
    var bx=document.createElement('div');
    bx.style.cssText='background:#fff;border-radius:16px;max-width:460px;width:100%;max-height:85vh;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4);padding:20px;border-top:5px solid #173a2b';
    var msg=document.createElement('div');
    msg.style.cssText='white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:#1c2b22;margin-bottom:14px;word-break:break-word';
    msg.textContent=o.msg; bx.appendChild(msg);
    var inp=null;
    if(o.type==='prompt'){
      inp=document.createElement('input'); inp.value=o.def||'';
      inp.style.cssText='width:100%;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #cfd8d2;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:14px';
      bx.appendChild(inp);
    }
    var row=document.createElement('div'); row.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end';
    function btn(txt,bg,fg,fn){
      var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.textContent=txt;
      b.style.cssText='border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;background:'+bg+';color:'+fg;
      b.onclick=fn; row.appendChild(b); return b;
    }
    function close(res){ document.removeEventListener('keydown',key,true); ov.remove(); if(o.done) o.done(res); next(); }
    function ok(){ close(inp?inp.value:true); }
    function no(){ close(inp?null:false); }
    if(o.type!=='alert') btn('Hủy','#e5e7eb','#374151',no);
    var okb=btn(o.type==='alert'?'Đóng':'Đồng ý','#173a2b','#fff',ok);
    function key(e){ if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();no();} else if(e.key==='Enter'&&!(e.target&&e.target.tagName==='TEXTAREA')){e.preventDefault();ok();} }
    document.addEventListener('keydown',key,true);
    bx.appendChild(row); ov.appendChild(bx); document.body.appendChild(ov);
    setTimeout(function(){ (inp||okb).focus(); },30);
  }

  window.alert=function(m){ show({type:'alert',msg:String(m==null?'':m)}); };
  window.confirm=function(m){
    m=String(m==null?'':m);
    if(approved[m]){ delete approved[m]; return true; }
    show({type:'confirm',msg:m,done:function(v){ if(v){ approved[m]=true; setTimeout(replay,0); } }});
    return false;
  };
  window.prompt=function(m,def){
    m=String(m==null?'':m);
    if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ptxt,m)){ var v=ptxt[m]; delete ptxt[m]; return v; }
    show({type:'prompt',msg:m,def:def,done:function(v){ if(v===null) return; ptxt[m]=v; setTimeout(replay,0); }});
    return null;
  };
  window.confirmAsync=function(m,cb){
    show({type:'confirm',msg:String(m==null?'':m),done:function(v){ if(v) setTimeout(function(){ try{cb();}catch(e){ alert('Lỗi: '+(e&&e.message||e)); } },0); }});
  };
})();
</script>
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Be+Vietnam+Pro:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mammoth@1.7.0/mammoth.browser.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.4/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<title>9 Sạch System</title>
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#1c2b22;
  --forest:#173a2b;
  --forest-2:#0e2a1f;
  --sage:#5c8368;
  --sage-soft:#e7efe6;
  --cream:#faf8f2;
  --cream-2:#f2ede1;
  --gold:#c98a2c;
  --gold-soft:#fbeed7;
  --gold-deep:#a3691b;
  --red:#b3261e;
  --amber:#b7791f;
  --blue:#1d4ed8;
  --purple:#6d28d9;
  --gray:#6b7a71;
  --line:#e4e1d4;
  --radius:14px;
  --radius-sm:9px;
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 3px rgba(23,58,43,.08), 0 1px 2px rgba(23,58,43,.06);
  --shadow-md:0 6px 20px rgba(23,58,43,.10);
  --shadow-lg:0 16px 40px rgba(23,58,43,.16);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.32,1);
  --invoice-w:400px;
  --sidenav-w:190px;
  --sidenav-w-collapsed:60px;
  --hd-h:54px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
body{background:var(--cream);font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:14px;margin:0;padding:0;padding-bottom:76px;color:var(--ink);}
h1,h2,h3,h4,h5{font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;}
::selection{background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--forest-2);}

#gBar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:0%;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#e9c37a,var(--gold));background-size:200%;z-index:99999;transition:width .3s;animation:shine 1.4s linear infinite;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;}
@keyframes shine{0%{background-position:200%}100%{background-position:0%}}
#gLbl{position:fixed;top:7px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--forest);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 14px;border-radius:20px;z-index:99999;display:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);letter-spacing:.2px;}

#loginScreen{position:fixed;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, #234c38 0%, var(--forest-2) 55%, #0a1d15 100%);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;}
.login-box{width:100%;max-width:360px;padding:36px 30px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.35);text-align:center;animation:loginIn .5s var(--ease);}
@keyframes loginIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
.login-box img{box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(201,138,44,.35);}
.main-content-hidden{display:none;}

.hd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--forest) 0%,var(--forest-2) 100%);color:#fff;padding:9px 14px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--gold);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:500;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.12);}
.hd-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.hd-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.3px;display:flex;align-items:center;}
.hd-user{font-size:11px;color:#cfe3d5;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600;}
.hd-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;}
.hd-actions .btn{font-size:11px;padding:5px 10px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:8px;border:none;transition:.15s var(--ease);}
.hd-actions .btn:active{transform:scale(.94);}

/* THANH MODULE DẠNG CỘT DỌC BÊN TRÁI - tông trầm, chuyên nghiệp */
.side-nav{position:fixed;top:var(--hd-h);left:0;bottom:0;width:var(--sidenav-w);background:#fbfaf6;border-right:1px solid var(--line);z-index:480;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;padding:12px 8px;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;transition:width .22s var(--ease);box-shadow:2px 0 10px rgba(23,58,43,.04);}
.side-nav.collapsed{width:var(--sidenav-w-collapsed);}
.side-nav .side-nav-toggle{background:transparent;color:var(--forest);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:10px;transition:.15s var(--ease);flex-shrink:0;}
.side-nav .side-nav-toggle:hover{background:var(--sage-soft);border-color:var(--sage);}
.side-nav .tnl{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;text-align:left;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:9px;flex-shrink:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;border-left:3px solid transparent;}
.side-nav .tnl:hover{filter:none;transform:none;box-shadow:none;background:var(--sage-soft);}
.side-nav .tnl:active{transform:none;background:#dde8de;}
.side-nav .tnl.active{background:var(--sage-soft);border-left-color:var(--gold);color:var(--forest);font-weight:800;}
.side-nav .tnl i{width:18px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:var(--gray);flex-shrink:0;}
.side-nav .tnl.active i{color:var(--forest);}
.side-nav.collapsed .tnl{justify-content:center;padding:10px 0;border-left:none;}
.side-nav .tnl .lbl{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.side-nav.collapsed .tnl .lbl{display:none;}
.side-nav-spacer{flex-grow:1;}
.page{margin-left:var(--sidenav-w);transition:margin-left .22s var(--ease);}
body.sidenav-collapsed .page{margin-left:var(--sidenav-w-collapsed);}
.tnl{font-weight:700;font-size:11px;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:8px;text-transform:uppercase;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s var(--ease);letter-spacing:.2px;}
.tnl:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.tnl:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.97);}
.tnl-red{background:#e53e3e;color:#fff;}.tnl-org{background:#dd6b20;color:#fff;}.tnl-blu{background:#3182ce;color:#fff;}.tnl-pur{background:#805ad5;color:#fff;}.tnl-grn{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;}.tnl-gray{background:#5f6f66;color:#fff;}.tnl-teal{background:#0f8391;color:#fff;}.tnl-pink{background:#b7245c;color:#fff;}.tnl-amber{background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;}.tnl-cyan{background:#0e7490;color:#fff;}.tnl-indigo{background:#4338ca;color:#fff;}
.tnl-brown{background:#7c4a02;color:#fff;}
.side-nav .tnl-brown i{color:#a3691b;}
/* Trong side-nav: chỉ tô màu icon (giữ nhận diện) thay vì cả nền nút - dịu mắt hơn */
.side-nav .tnl-red i{color:#e5534b;}.side-nav .tnl-org i{color:#c9762e;}.side-nav .tnl-blu i{color:#3a7bc0;}
.side-nav .tnl-pur i{color:#7c5cb8;}.side-nav .tnl-grn i{color:var(--forest);}.side-nav .tnl-gray i{color:#6b7a71;}
.side-nav .tnl-teal i{color:#158a95;}.side-nav .tnl-pink i{color:#a94369;}.side-nav .tnl-amber i{color:var(--gold-deep);}
.side-nav .tnl-cyan i{color:#1a7d95;}.side-nav .tnl-indigo i{color:#4f52a8;}

/* KPI / BI DASHBOARD */
.kpi-card{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.18s var(--ease);}
.kpi-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.kpi-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--forest),var(--gold));}
.kpi-lbl{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.kpi-val{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest);line-height:1.15;}
.kpi-cmp{font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;color:var(--gray);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.kpi-delta{font-weight:800;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11.5px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;}
.kpi-delta.up{background:#d1fae5;color:#065f46;}
.kpi-delta.down{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;}
.kpi-delta.flat{background:#e5e7eb;color:#374151;}

.warn-box{border-radius:12px;padding:12px 15px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.warn-box.danger{background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fecaca;color:#991b1b;}
.warn-box.warning{background:#fffbeb;border:1px solid #fde68a;color:#92400e;}
.warn-box.success{background:#ecfdf5;border:1px solid #a7f3d0;color:#065f46;}
.warn-box i{margin-top:2px;font-size:15px;}

.chart-card{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);height:100%;}
.chart-card h6{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.chart-wrap{position:relative;height:260px;}
.chart-wrap.sm{height:220px;}
.chart-err{width:100%;}

/* SO SÁNH THEO THÁNG (cột, tăng xanh / giảm đỏ + mũi tên %) */
.mc-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;}
.mc-table th{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;padding:8px 10px;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:700;text-align:center;}
.mc-table td{padding:9px 10px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid #f2f0e8;white-space:nowrap;}
.mc-table tbody tr:hover{background:var(--sage-soft);}
.mc-rev{font-weight:800;color:var(--forest);}
.mc-delta{font-weight:800;font-size:11px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:14px;}
.mc-delta.up{background:#d1fae5;color:#065f46;}
.mc-delta.down{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;}
.mc-delta.flat{background:#e5e7eb;color:#374151;}

/* DROPDOWN CHỌN NHIỀU NHÂN VIÊN (dùng chung: Doanh Thu + Lịch Sử) */
.ms-dd-wrap{position:relative;}
.ms-dd-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;}
.ms-dd-panel{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);z-index:900;max-height:220px;overflow-y:auto;margin-top:4px;padding:6px;}
.ms-dd-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12.5px;}
.ms-dd-item:hover{background:var(--sage-soft);}
.ms-dd-item input{cursor:pointer;}

.bottom-nav{display:none;position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--line);z-index:600;padding:5px 0 max(4px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));box-shadow:0 -4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.06);}
.bn-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;}
.bn-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray);background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:5px 6px;border-radius:10px;min-width:52px;transition:.15s var(--ease);}
.bn-item i{font-size:18px;}
.bn-item.active,.bn-item:active{color:var(--forest);}
.bn-fab{color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--forest),var(--forest-2));border-radius:50%;width:54px;height:54px;margin-top:-20px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(23,58,43,.45);font-size:10px;padding:2px;border:3px solid #fff;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px;transition:.15s var(--ease);}
.bn-fab:active{transform:scale(.93);}
.bn-fab i{font-size:20px;}

.page{display:none;}.page.active{display:block;animation:pageIn .25s var(--ease);}
@keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.order-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 420px;gap:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:padding-left .28s var(--ease);}
@media(max-width:991px){.order-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:8px;}}

#editOrderBanner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff3cd,#ffe9a8);border:1.5px solid #f0c14b;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:11px 14px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.price-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#fbeed7);border:1.5px solid var(--gold);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}

/* DANH MỤC SẢN PHẨM (nút lọc) */
.cat-filter-bar{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;}
.cat-btn{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--forest);font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s var(--ease);white-space:nowrap;}
.cat-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-1px);}
.cat-btn.active{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border-color:var(--forest);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
/* [MỤC 3] thanh tìm kiếm SP */
#pgToolbar{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;}
#pgToolbar .cat-filter-bar{flex:1 1 220px;min-width:0;margin-bottom:0;}
.pg-search{position:relative;flex:0 1 190px;min-width:150px;}
.pg-search input{width:100%;height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#14241D);font-size:13px;padding:0 32px 0 34px;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;}
.pg-search input:focus{border-color:var(--gold,#C9A24B);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(201,162,75,.2);}
.pg-s-ico{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;width:15px;height:15px;margin-top:-7.5px;color:var(--gray,#6A7B73);pointer-events:none;}
.pg-s-x{position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;width:24px;height:24px;margin-top:-12px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cream-2,#E4EBE6);color:var(--g8,#103A2D);font-size:10px;line-height:24px;padding:0;cursor:pointer;display:none;}
.pg-search.has .pg-s-x{display:block;}
.pg-hide{display:none!important;}
/* [MỤC 5] FLIP đổi chỗ ô SP + rung khi bấm giữ */
#productGrid>[data-pid]{backface-visibility:hidden;}
#productGrid>.pg-moving{position:relative;z-index:3;will-change:transform;}
@keyframes pgShake{0%{translate:0 0;rotate:0deg}14%{translate:-2.5px 0;rotate:-2.4deg}28%{translate:2.5px 0;rotate:2.2deg}42%{translate:-2px 0;rotate:-1.8deg}56%{translate:2px 0;rotate:1.5deg}70%{translate:-1px 0;rotate:-.9deg}84%{translate:.8px 0;rotate:.5deg}100%{translate:0 0;rotate:0deg}}
#productGrid>.pg-shake{animation:pgShake .5s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97) both;position:relative;z-index:4;}
#productGrid .product-card{-webkit-touch-callout:none;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#productGrid>.pg-shake{animation:none;}}
/* [MỤC 6] Khung nhập số lượng (bấm giữ ô SP) */
#pgQtyOv{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:5200;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(14,30,22,0);transition:background .22s ease;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
#pgQtyOv.on{display:flex;}
#pgQtyOv.in{background:rgba(14,30,22,.5);}
.pgq-card{width:min(340px,100%);background:#fff;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(10,24,18,.38);padding:16px 16px 14px;transform:translateY(20px) scale(.96);opacity:0;transition:transform .26s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .2s ease;}
#pgQtyOv.in .pgq-card{transform:none;opacity:1;}
.pgq-hd{margin-bottom:12px;padding-right:2px;}
.pgq-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest,#173A2B);line-height:1.3;word-break:break-word;}
.pgq-price{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray,#6A7B73);margin-top:2px;font-weight:600;}
.pgq-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.pgq-b{flex:0 0 54px;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:16px;border:1.5px solid var(--line,#DDE5E0);background:var(--cream-2,#E4EBE6);color:var(--forest,#173A2B);font-size:26px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:0;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .12s ease,background .15s;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;}
.pgq-b:active{transform:scale(.92);background:#d6e2da;}
#pgQtyInput{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;width:100%;height:54px;border:1.5px solid var(--line,#DDE5E0);border-radius:16px;text-align:center;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest,#173A2B);background:#fff;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;-moz-appearance:textfield;padding:0 6px;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;}
#pgQtyInput:focus{border-color:var(--gold,#C9A24B);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(201,162,75,.22);}
#pgQtyInput::-webkit-outer-spin-button,#pgQtyInput::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0;}
.pgq-grab{display:none;width:40px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:#cfd8d2;margin:-6px auto 12px;touch-action:none;position:relative;}
.pgq-grab:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-20px;right:-20px;top:-14px;bottom:-14px;}
.pgq-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;}
.pgq-chips button{flex:1 1 0;height:36px;border:1.5px solid var(--line,#DDE5E0);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--forest,#173A2B);font-size:14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .12s ease,background .15s;}
.pgq-chips button:active{transform:scale(.94);background:var(--cream-2,#E4EBE6);}
.pgq-sum{min-height:18px;text-align:center;margin:10px 0 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--forest,#173A2B);}
.pgq-act{display:flex;gap:10px;}
.pgq-act button{height:46px;border-radius:14px;border:0;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .12s ease,filter .15s;}
.pgq-act button:active{transform:scale(.97);}
.pgq-ok{flex:1 1 auto;background:var(--forest,#173A2B);color:#fff;}
.pgq-rm{flex:0 0 auto;padding:0 16px;background:#fdecea;color:#b3261e;}
@media(max-width:768px){.pgq-grab{display:block;}#pgQtyOv{align-items:flex-end;padding:0;}.pgq-card{width:100%;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;padding:16px 16px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#pgQtyOv,.pgq-card{transition:none;}}
/* [LỊCH SỬ MOBILE] danh sách đơn dạng thẻ, nút to dễ bấm, không phải kéo ngang */
#hisCards{display:none;}
@media(max-width:768px){
  #page-history .tbl-wrap{display:none;}
  #hisCards{display:block;padding-bottom:84px;}
  #page-history .filter-bar{padding:10px;border-radius:14px;}
  #page-history .filter-bar label{font-size:11px;margin-bottom:2px;}
  #page-history .filter-bar .d-flex{gap:8px!important;}
  #page-history .filter-bar .stat-card{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px!important;justify-content:space-between;}
}
.hc{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(23,58,43,.09);margin-bottom:12px;border-left:5px solid var(--forest,#173A2B);overflow:hidden;}
.hc.wait{border-left-color:#f59e0b;} .hc.ok{border-left-color:#16a34a;}
.hc-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px 6px;}
.hc-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest,#173A2B);line-height:1.25;word-break:break-word;}
.hc-phone{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:3px;font-size:13px;color:#0f766e;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;padding:3px 0;}
.hc-mst{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--gray,#6A7B73);margin-top:1px;}
.hc-total{font-size:17px;font-weight:900;color:#dc2626;white-space:nowrap;text-align:right;}
.hc-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 14px 8px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--gray,#6A7B73);}
.hc-chip{display:inline-block;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--forest,#173A2B);color:#fff;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;}
.hc-chip.alt{background:var(--cream-2,#E4EBE6);color:var(--forest,#173A2B);}
.hc-chip.wait{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;} .hc-chip.ok{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;}
.hc-items{border-top:1px dashed var(--line,#DDE5E0);padding:6px 14px;}
.hc-it{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;padding:5px 0;font-size:13px;}
.hc-q{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:34px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest,#173A2B);}
.hc-n{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;word-break:break-word;}
.hc-v{flex:0 0 auto;font-weight:700;color:#dc2626;font-size:12.5px;}
.hc-rest{display:none;} .hc.open .hc-rest{display:block;}
.hc-more{width:100%;border:0;background:none;color:#0f766e;font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;padding:8px 0 4px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}
.hc-note{margin:0 14px 8px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:#f6f8f6;font-size:12px;color:var(--gray,#6A7B73);word-break:break-word;}
.hc-act{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;padding:8px 12px 12px;}
.hc-act button{min-height:48px;border:0;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .12s ease,filter .15s;}
.hc-act button i{font-size:16px;}
.hc-act button:active{transform:scale(.95);filter:brightness(.92);}
.hc-copy{background:#16a34a;color:#fff;} .hc-date{background:#0891b2;color:#fff;} .hc-edit{background:#f59e0b;color:#1f2937;}
/* [MỤC 9] bỏ trễ ~300ms của chạm đúp-phóng to trên cảm ứng (vẫn cuộn và chụm-phóng được) */
html{touch-action:manipulation;}
/* [MỤC 7] Tự sắp xếp vị trí bánh theo user */
.pg-ord{display:flex;gap:6px;flex:0 0 auto;align-items:center;}
.pg-ord-b{border:1.5px solid var(--line,#DDE5E0);background:#fff;color:var(--forest,#173A2B);font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;height:36px;padding:0 13px;border-radius:20px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:.15s var(--ease,ease);touch-action:manipulation;}
.pg-ord-b:hover{border-color:var(--gold,#C9A24B);}
.pg-ord-b.on{background:var(--gold,#C9A24B);border-color:var(--gold,#C9A24B);color:#fff;}
.pg-ord-reset{display:none;}
#pgToolbar.pg-editing .pg-ord-reset{display:inline-block;}
.pg-mv{display:none;position:absolute;left:50%;top:44%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:12;gap:8px;}
#productGrid.pg-editing .pg-mv{display:flex;}
.pg-mv button{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(23,58,43,.88);color:#fff;font-size:15px;line-height:1;padding:0;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3);touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .12s ease;}
.pg-mv button:active{transform:scale(.88);}
#productGrid.pg-editing .product-card{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(201,162,75,.6),0 6px 16px rgba(23,58,43,.10);transition:box-shadow .25s ease;}
#pgEditBar{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(76px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:900;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 8px 8px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(23,58,43,.92);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(10,24,18,.38);max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,24px) scale(.96);transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .22s ease;}
#pgEditBar.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1);}
#pgEditBar span{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;opacity:.92;}
#pgEditBar button{height:36px;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:0 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;}
#pgEditBar button.ok{background:var(--gold,#C9A24B);}
@media(min-width:769px){#pgEditBar{bottom:22px;}}
@media(max-width:480px){#pgEditBar span{display:none;}#pgEditBar{padding:8px;}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#pgEditBar{transition:none;}}
.pg-mv{gap:6px;}
.pg-mv button{width:32px;height:32px;font-size:14px;}
.pg-grip{touch-action:none;cursor:grab;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.pg-grip svg{width:16px;height:16px;pointer-events:none;}
#productGrid.pg-editing>[data-pid]{cursor:grab;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;}
#productGrid>.pg-drag{position:relative;z-index:40;transform-origin:0 0;will-change:transform;cursor:grabbing;}
#productGrid>.pg-drag .product-card{box-shadow:0 22px 46px rgba(10,24,18,.42);outline:2px solid var(--gold,#C9A24B);outline-offset:-2px;}
@media(max-width:480px){.pg-mv{gap:4px;}.pg-mv button{width:30px;height:30px;}}
@media(max-width:768px){.pg-ord{flex:1 1 100%;order:-1;}.pg-ord-b{height:40px;flex:1 1 auto;font-size:13px;}.pg-search{order:-2;}}
#pgNoMatch{display:none;text-align:center;color:var(--gray,#6A7B73);padding:22px 8px;font-size:13px;}
@media(max-width:768px){.pg-search{flex:1 1 100%;order:-1;}.pg-search input{height:40px;font-size:16px;}}

/* SẢN PHẨM DẠNG VUÔNG */
.product-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);background:#fff;position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s var(--ease);overflow:hidden;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.product-card:active{transform:scale(.96);}
.product-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);border-color:#d7ceb4;}
.product-img-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;background:var(--cream-2);overflow:hidden;}
.product-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s var(--ease);}
.product-card:hover .product-img{transform:scale(1.06);}
.product-body{padding:6px 4px 8px;text-align:center;}
.product-name{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25;padding:0 2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.product-detail{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.15;padding:0 3px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.product-price{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--red);}
.product-cat-tag{position:absolute;bottom:5px;left:5px;background:rgba(23,58,43,.82);color:#fff;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;z-index:9;letter-spacing:.2px;}
.q-badge{position:absolute;top:5px;right:5px;background:var(--gold);color:#fff;border-radius:50%;width:21px;height:21px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border:2px solid #fff;z-index:10;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
.btn-edit-sp{position:absolute;top:5px;left:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:6px;width:23px;height:23px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;color:#444;z-index:11;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;}
.btn-edit-sp:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;border-color:var(--gold);}

.cart-wrap{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 16px 0;position:sticky;top:64px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);border-top:5px solid var(--forest);max-height:calc(100vh - 80px);overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.cart-scroll{flex-grow:1;}
.cart-footer{position:sticky;bottom:0;background:#fff;margin:0 -16px;padding:10px 16px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 -6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.06);z-index:6;}
.cart-hd-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:9px;margin-bottom:9px;}
.btn-bill-toggle{background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold-deep);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 11px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s var(--ease);white-space:nowrap;}
.btn-bill-toggle:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;}
.btn-bill-toggle.active{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border-color:var(--forest);}
.section-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest);margin:14px 0 7px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding-left:8px;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;}
.cust-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;cursor:pointer;padding:8px 11px;background:var(--sage-soft);border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #d6e4d9;margin-bottom:9px;transition:.15s;}
.cust-header:hover{background:#dbe9dd;}
#custBody.collapsed{display:none;}
#statusHint{display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;min-height:18px;}

.addr-wrap{position:relative;}
.addr-dd{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:none;border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;max-height:220px;overflow-y:auto;z-index:5000;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);display:none;}
.addr-item{padding:9px 13px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid #f2f0e8;transition:.1s;}
.addr-item:hover,.addr-item.hi{background:var(--sage-soft);color:var(--forest);font-weight:700;}
.addr-item b{color:var(--gold-deep);font-weight:800;}
.addr-empty{padding:12px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gray);text-align:center;}

.cmodal-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(14,30,22,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);z-index:2000;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;}
.cmodal-overlay.open{display:flex;}
.cmodal{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;width:100%;max-width:480px;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.35);animation:cmIn .22s var(--ease);}
@keyframes cmIn{from{transform:translateY(26px) scale(.98);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0) scale(1);opacity:1}}
.cmodal-sm{max-width:360px;}
.cmodal-xl{max-width:780px;}
.cmodal-hd{padding:15px 18px;font-weight:800;font-size:14.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;}
.cmodal-hd.green{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--forest),var(--forest-2));color:#fff;}
.cmodal-hd.blue{background:#0891b2;color:#fff;}
.cmodal-hd.amber{background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;}
.cmodal-hd.dark{background:#1e293b;color:#fff;}
.cmodal-hd.warn{background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;}
.cmodal-hd.danger{background:#dc2626;color:#fff;}
.cmodal-body{padding:18px;}
.cmodal-ft{padding:13px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;}
.cmodal-ft.between{justify-content:space-between;}
.cmodal-close{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border:none;color:inherit;border-radius:8px;width:28px;height:28px;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:.15s;}
.cmodal-close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);}

.page-hd{color:#fff;padding:13px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;position:sticky;top:48px;z-index:400;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.page-hd h4{margin:0;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;flex-grow:1;letter-spacing:.2px;}
.btn-back{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;}
.btn-back:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.32);}
.btn-xls{background:#fff;color:var(--forest);border:none;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:.15s;}
.btn-xls:hover{background:var(--gold-soft);transform:translateY(-1px);}
.page-body{padding:12px;}
.filter-bar{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:15px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.stats-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:11px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.stat-card{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:15px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);border-left:4px solid var(--forest);transition:.15s;}
.stat-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transform:translateY(-1px);}
.stat-card.red{border-left-color:var(--red);}
.stat-card.blue{border-left-color:var(--blue);}
.stat-card.amber{border-left-color:var(--amber);}
.stat-card.purple{border-left-color:var(--purple);}
.stat-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600;}
.stat-val{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest);}
.stat-val.red{color:var(--red);}
.stat-val.blue{color:var(--blue);}
.stat-val.amber{color:var(--amber);}
.stat-val.purple{color:var(--purple);}
.tbl-wrap{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.tbl-wrap table{font-size:12px;margin:0;width:100%;}
.tbl-wrap thead th{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;padding:10px 11px;}
.tbl-wrap tbody tr{transition:.1s;}
.tbl-wrap tbody tr:hover{background:var(--sage-soft);}
.tbl-wrap td{padding:8px 11px;vertical-align:middle;border-bottom:1px solid #f2f0e8;}
.bs{padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;display:inline-block;}
.bs-wait{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;}
.bs-ok{background:#d1fae5;color:#065f46;}
.bs-late{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;}
.bs-ext{background:#e0e7ff;color:#3730a3;}
.bs-part{background:#dbeafe;color:#1e40af;}
.copy-box{white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:'Consolas',monospace;font-size:12.5px;background:var(--cream-2);padding:14px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;line-height:1.6;}
.note-chip{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--forest);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:background .12s,color .12s;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
.note-chip.on{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border-color:var(--forest);}

/* upload ảnh sản phẩm */
.img-upload-zone{border:2px dashed #d7ceb4;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;background:var(--cream-2);}
.img-upload-zone:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-soft);}
.img-upload-zone.dragover{border-color:var(--forest);background:var(--sage-soft);}
.img-upload-zone i{font-size:26px;color:var(--gold-deep);margin-bottom:4px;display:block;}
.upload-progress{height:5px;background:#eee;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px;display:none;}
.upload-progress-bar{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--forest));width:0%;transition:width .2s;}

/* HÓA ĐƠN TRƯỢT BÊN TRÁI (desktop/web) */
#invoicePanel{position:fixed;top:0;left:calc(-1 * var(--invoice-w) - 10px);width:var(--invoice-w);height:100vh;background:#fdfcf8;box-shadow:8px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18);z-index:1500;transition:left .3s var(--ease);display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-right:4px solid var(--gold);}
#invoicePanel.open{left:0;}
.inv-hd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--forest),var(--forest-2));color:#fff;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.inv-hd b{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.3px;}
.inv-body{padding:0;overflow-y:auto;flex-grow:1;}
.inv-paper{background:#fff;margin:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);overflow:hidden;}
.inv-letterhead{text-align:center;padding:16px 14px 12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--forest);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--cream-2));}
.inv-company{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:900;color:var(--forest);letter-spacing:.4px;}
.inv-tagline{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--gold-deep);font-style:italic;font-weight:700;margin-top:1px;}
.inv-doctitle{font-size:16px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:9px;color:var(--ink);}
.inv-meta{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:3px;}
.inv-cust-block{padding:12px 16px 4px;}
.inv-field{margin-bottom:9px;}
.inv-field label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;display:block;margin-bottom:3px;}
.inv-field input,.inv-field textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 9px;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;background:var(--cream-2);}
.inv-field input:focus,.inv-field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--gold);background:#fff;}
.inv-field input[readonly]{background:#f4f2ea;color:var(--gray);}
.inv-table-wrap{padding:6px 16px 0;}
.inv-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;}
.inv-table thead th{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;padding:6px 7px;font-weight:700;text-align:left;}
.inv-table thead th.c{text-align:center;}.inv-table thead th.r{text-align:right;}
.inv-table tbody td{padding:6px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0eee4;vertical-align:top;}
.inv-table tbody td.c{text-align:center;}.inv-table tbody td.r{text-align:right;font-weight:700;color:var(--forest);white-space:nowrap;}
.inv-total-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:16px;color:var(--red);padding:10px 16px;margin:0 0 4px;background:var(--gold-soft);border-top:1.5px dashed var(--gold);border-bottom:1.5px dashed var(--gold);}
.inv-sign-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 16px 18px;font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);text-align:center;}
.inv-sign-row div{flex:1;}
.inv-sign-row b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:32px;font-size:11.5px;}
.inv-footer-note{text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:var(--gray);padding:0 16px 14px;}
.inv-ft{padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;gap:8px;background:#fff;}
#invoiceBackdrop{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);z-index:1490;}
#invoiceBackdrop.open{display:block;}
@media(max-width:991px){
  #invoicePanel{width:88vw;--invoice-w:88vw;}
}

/* CÔNG NỢ - THEO DÕI THEO KHÁCH SỈ */
.debt-cust-card{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 15px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);margin-bottom:9px;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid var(--line);transition:.15s var(--ease);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.debt-cust-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
.debt-cust-card.warning{border-color:#dc2626;animation:debtBlink 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes debtBlink{0%,100%{background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}50%{background:#fee2e2;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(220,38,38,.35);}}
.debt-cust-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;}
.debt-cust-name{font-weight:800;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--forest);}
.debt-cust-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);}
.debt-cust-remain{font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:var(--red);}
.debt-warning-badge{background:#dc2626;color:#fff;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;letter-spacing:.2px;}

.debt-detail-hd{background:#0e1b16;color:#fff;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;padding:12px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.debt-detail-hd select,.debt-detail-hd input{border-radius:8px;border:none;padding:6px 10px;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;}
.debt-summary-pill{background:#fff;color:#0e1b16;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 14px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;}
.debt-summary-pill.red{color:#dc2626;}
.dtbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px;background:#fff;}
.dtbl thead th{background:#0e1b16;color:#fff;padding:9px 10px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;text-align:center;}
.dtbl tbody td{padding:9px 10px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;white-space:nowrap;}
.dtbl tbody tr.warning-row{animation:debtBlink 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;}
.dtbl tbody tr:hover{background:var(--sage-soft);}
.btn-pay{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;}
.btn-pay:hover{background:var(--forest-2);}

body.mobile-mode{font-size:16px !important;}
body.mobile-mode .order-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;padding:6px;}
body.mobile-mode .cart-wrap{position:static;border-radius:12px;margin-top:8px;max-height:none;overflow:visible;}
body.mobile-mode .cart-footer{position:static;box-shadow:none;margin:0;padding:10px 0 0;}
body.mobile-mode .form-control,body.mobile-mode .form-select{font-size:16px !important;height:46px;}
body.mobile-mode textarea.form-control{height:auto !important;}
body.mobile-mode .btn{font-size:15px !important;padding:10px 14px !important;min-height:46px;}
body.mobile-mode #btnSubmit{font-size:17px !important;padding:14px !important;min-height:54px;border-radius:12px;}
body.mobile-mode #totalDisplay{font-size:22px !important;}
body.mobile-mode .side-nav{display:none !important;}
body.mobile-mode .page{margin-left:0 !important;}
body.mobile-mode .bottom-nav{display:block !important;}
body.mobile-mode .hide-mobile{display:none !important;}
body.mobile-mode #productGrid .col-4{flex:0 0 50%;max-width:50%;padding:3px;}
@media(max-width:768px){body{padding-bottom:80px;}.side-nav{display:none;}.page{margin-left:0 !important;}.bottom-nav{display:block;}.hd-title{font-size:13px;}.hide-mobile{display:none !important;}#productGrid .col-4{flex:0 0 33.33%;max-width:33.33%;padding:3px;}.cart-wrap{position:static;max-height:none;overflow:visible;}.cart-footer{position:static;box-shadow:none;margin:0;padding:10px 0 0;}}
@media(max-width:480px){#productGrid .col-4{flex:0 0 50%;max-width:50%;}}
#pdfReceipt{display:none;}
#pdfReceipt table tr,#pdfInvoicePanel table tr{page-break-inside:avoid;break-inside:avoid;}
@media print{body *{visibility:hidden;}#pdfReceipt,#pdfReceipt *{visibility:visible;}#pdfReceipt{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:100%;padding:20px;display:block !important;}}
/* Overlay hiển thị thật khi xuất PDF (thay cho đặt off-screen) */
#pdfRenderOverlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(14,27,20,.55);z-index:6000;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;overflow-y:auto;padding:36px 12px;}
#pdfRenderOverlay.show{display:flex;}
.pdf-render-label{color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:.3px;}
.pdf-render-frame{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4);overflow:hidden;}
input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0;}
input[type=number]{-moz-appearance:textfield;}
.toast-msg{position:fixed;bottom:90px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:11px 26px;border-radius:26px;font-weight:700;z-index:9999;font-size:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);color:#fff;pointer-events:none;animation:toastIn .25s var(--ease);}
@keyframes toastIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}}
.btn-success{background:var(--forest) !important;border-color:var(--forest) !important;}
.btn-success:hover{background:var(--forest-2) !important;border-color:var(--forest-2) !important;}
.form-control:focus,.form-select:focus{border-color:var(--sage) !important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(92,131,104,.15) !important;}
/* [MỚI v7] chỉ báo bảng có thể sắp xếp bằng cách bấm vào tiêu đề cột */
.tbl-wrap thead th,.mc-table thead th,.dtbl thead th{cursor:pointer;user-select:none;}
.tbl-wrap thead th:hover,.mc-table thead th:hover,.dtbl thead th:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);}
.tbl-wrap thead th.sorted-col,.mc-table thead th.sorted-col,.dtbl thead th.sorted-col{background:rgba(201,138,44,.35) !important;}
/* [MỚI] KHÁCH HÀNG TMĐT - bảng xổ lên (bottom sheet) */
.bottom-sheet-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(14,30,22,.55);z-index:5000;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;}
.bottom-sheet-overlay.open{display:flex;}
.bottom-sheet{background:#fff;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;width:100%;max-width:760px;max-height:82vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 -14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25);animation:bsUp .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.32,1);}
@keyframes bsUp{from{transform:translateY(30px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
.bottom-sheet-hd{position:sticky;top:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--forest),var(--forest-2));color:#fff;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;z-index:2;}
.bottom-sheet-body{padding:14px 16px 24px;}

.code-box{background:var(--sage-soft);border:1px dashed var(--forest);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.code-box input#custCode{letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--forest);background:#fff;}
.rc-sec{font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:var(--forest);margin:10px 0 4px;}
.rc-ctl{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--gold-soft);border:1px solid #efd6a3;}
.cdx-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.cdx-stat{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);border-left:4px solid var(--forest);cursor:default;}
.cdx-stat.click{cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;}.cdx-stat.click:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md,0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.12));}
.cdx-stat .l{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;}
.cdx-stat .v{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--forest);line-height:1.15;}
.cdx-stat .s{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray);}
.cdx-stat.warn{border-left-color:#d97706;}.cdx-stat.warn .v{color:#b45309;}
.cdx-stat.blue{border-left-color:#2563eb;}.cdx-stat.blue .v{color:#1d4ed8;}
.cdx-stat.gold{border-left-color:var(--gold);}.cdx-stat.gold .v{color:#92400e;}
.cdx-card{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);padding:12px;}
.cdx-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:10px;}
.cdx-tabs .cust-tab{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#f8faf8;color:#334;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;}
.cdx-tabs .cust-tab i{margin-right:4px;opacity:.75;}
.cdx-tabs .cust-tab .badge{background:#e5ece7;color:var(--forest);margin-left:4px;font-size:11px;}
.cdx-tabs .cust-tab.active{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border-color:var(--forest);}
.cdx-tabs .cust-tab.active .badge{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#fff;}
.cdx-tabs .cust-tab.warn:not(.active){color:#92400e;background:#fffbeb;border-color:#fcd34d;}
.cdx-tabs .cust-tab.warn:not(.active) .badge{background:#fde68a;color:#92400e;}
.cdx-toolbar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;}
.cdx-toolbar select{width:auto;min-width:130px;}
.cdx-search{position:relative;flex:1 1 280px;min-width:220px;}
.cdx-search i{position:absolute;left:11px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:#8a9a90;font-size:13px;}
.cdx-search input{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:7px 12px 7px 32px;font-size:13px;background:#f8faf8;}
.cdx-search input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--forest);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(31,95,59,.12);}
.cdx-count{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);font-weight:600;margin-left:auto;white-space:nowrap;}
.cdx-tbl-wrap{max-height:calc(100vh - 360px);min-height:240px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;}
.cdx-tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;font-size:12.5px;}
.cdx-tbl thead th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;background:#f1f5f2;color:#40524a;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;}
.cdx-tbl tbody td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef2ef;vertical-align:top;}
.cdx-tbl tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#fbfcfb;}
.cdx-tbl tbody tr:hover{background:#f3f8f4;}
.cdx-code{display:inline-block;font-family:Consolas,Menlo,monospace;font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:7px;background:#e8f3ec;color:#14532d;border:1px solid #bfe0cb;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.2px;}
.cdx-code.g-CH{background:#e0f2fe;color:#075985;border-color:#bae6fd;}
.cdx-code.g-ST{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border-color:#fde68a;}
.cdx-code.g-HCTM,.cdx-code.g-HCGC,.cdx-code.g-HC{background:#f3e8ff;color:#6b21a8;border-color:#e9d5ff;}
.cdx-code.g-XK{background:#ffe4e6;color:#9f1239;border-color:#fecdd3;}
.cdx-code.g-DL1{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;border-color:#bbf7d0;}
.cdx-nm{font-weight:800;color:#1c2b22;font-size:13px;}
.cdx-sub{font-size:11.5px;color:#6b7b72;line-height:1.35;}
.cdx-chip{display:inline-block;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;background:#eef2ef;color:#40524a;margin:0 3px 3px 0;white-space:nowrap;}
.cdx-chip.f-CT{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;}.cdx-chip.f-ĐN{background:#dbeafe;color:#1e40af;}
.cdx-chip.nocode{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;}
.cdx-addr{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;max-width:340px;}
.cdx-act{white-space:nowrap;}
.cdx-act button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;width:30px;height:30px;color:#40524a;cursor:pointer;margin-right:3px;}
.cdx-act button:hover{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border-color:var(--forest);}
.cdx-act button.danger:hover{background:#dc2626;border-color:#dc2626;}
.cdx-act button.assign{width:auto;padding:0 10px;background:#f59e0b;color:#fff;border-color:#f59e0b;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;}
.cdx-pager{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--gray);}
.cdx-pager .pg button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--forest);cursor:pointer;margin-left:4px;}
.cdx-pager .pg button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;}
.cdx-audit-kpi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.cdx-audit-kpi div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;}
.cdx-audit-kpi b{display:block;font-size:20px;}
.cdx-audit-kpi .bad b{color:#dc2626;}.cdx-audit-kpi .ok b{color:#16a34a;}
@media (max-width:900px){.cdx-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.cdx-hide-md{display:none;}.cdx-tbl-wrap{max-height:calc(100vh - 300px);}}
.cd-tag{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:var(--sage-soft);color:var(--forest);white-space:nowrap;}
.cd-code{font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:700;color:var(--forest);white-space:nowrap;}
.cust-tab{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--forest);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:20px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;}
.cust-tab .badge{background:var(--sage-soft);color:var(--forest);margin-left:4px;}
.cust-tab.active{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border-color:var(--forest);}
.cust-tab.active .badge{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;}
</style>
<style id="polish-9sach">
/* ===== DOCK LIỀN KHỐI: nút "i" của Google nằm gọn ở đầu trái của thanh tab dưới ===== */
:root{
  --i-size:42px;      /* cạnh hộp "i" (đã chỉnh khớp) */
  --i-left:15px;      /* hộp "i" cách mép trái (đã chỉnh khớp) */
  --i-bottom:24px;    /* hộp "i" cách đáy (đã chỉnh khớp) */
  --nav-h:calc(var(--i-size) + 24px);                          /* chiều cao dock */
  --dock-b:max(6px, calc(var(--i-bottom) - 12px));             /* dock cách đáy */
  --dock-l:max(4px, calc(var(--i-left) - 11px));               /* dock cách trái */
  --dock-top:calc(var(--dock-b) + var(--nav-h));               /* mép trên của dock */
}
.hd-title{user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;}

/* ---------- ĐẾ HUY HIỆU DƯỚI NÚT "i" ---------- */
body::before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  left:calc(var(--i-left) - 4px);
  bottom:calc(var(--i-bottom) - 4px);
  width:calc(var(--i-size) + 8px);
  height:calc(var(--i-size) + 8px);
  box-sizing:border-box;
  border-radius:calc(var(--i-size) * .45);
  border:2px solid transparent;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 16%, var(--gold) 0 3.5px, #fff 3.5px 6px, transparent 6px) padding-box,
    linear-gradient(#fff,#fff) padding-box,
    linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold) 0%,#e9c37a 45%,var(--forest) 100%) border-box;
  box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(23,58,43,.20),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08),inset 0 0 0 3px #fff;
  z-index:10000;
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* ---------- ĐIỆN THOẠI (từ 768px trở xuống, hoặc bật Mobile Mode): dock ôm lấy "i" ---------- */
html[data-vp="phone"] .bottom-nav{
  display:block;
  left:var(--dock-l);
  right:auto;
  width:min(640px, calc(100% - var(--dock-l) - 8px));
  max-width:none;
  bottom:var(--dock-b);
  height:var(--nav-h);
  padding:0 8px 0 calc(var(--i-left) - var(--dock-l) + var(--i-size) + 12px);
  border:1px solid rgba(23,58,43,.10);
  border-radius:calc(var(--nav-h) / 2);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(23,58,43,.20),0 2px 6px rgba(23,58,43,.06);
}
/* vạch ngăn giữa "i" và các tab */
html[data-vp="phone"] .bottom-nav::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:15px;
  bottom:15px;
  left:calc(var(--i-left) + var(--i-size) + 7px - var(--dock-l));
  width:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#d9d4bf 30%,#d9d4bf 70%,transparent);
}
html[data-vp="phone"] .bn-inner{
  position:relative;
  height:100%;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));
  align-items:center;
}
html[data-vp="phone"] .bn-item{
  min-width:0;
  align-self:stretch;
  justify-content:center;
  padding:2px 1px;
  gap:1px;
  border-radius:14px;
  font-size:clamp(8.5px,2.5vw,10px);
  letter-spacing:.1px;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
html[data-vp="phone"] .bn-item i{font-size:clamp(16px,5vw,19px);}
html[data-vp="phone"] .bn-item:active{background:var(--sage-soft);}
html[data-vp="phone"] .bn-fab{
  justify-self:center;
  align-self:center;
  width:clamp(44px,13vw,52px);
  height:clamp(44px,13vw,52px);
  margin:0;
  transform:translateY(-8px);
  border:3px solid #fff;
  box-shadow:0 10px 22px -6px rgba(23,58,43,.55);
}
html[data-vp="phone"] .bn-fab:active{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(.93);}
html[data-vp="phone"] .bn-fab i{font-size:clamp(16px,5vw,20px);}
html[data-vp="phone"] .bn-fab span{font-size:clamp(7px,2.2vw,9px) !important;}

/* nội dung cuối trang, thông báo, menu "Thêm", popup: luôn nằm trên dock / không bị "i" che */
html[data-vp="phone"] body{padding-bottom:calc(var(--dock-top) + 22px);}
html[data-vp="phone"] .toast-msg{bottom:calc(var(--dock-top) + 14px);}
html[data-vp="phone"] #moreMenu{bottom:calc(var(--dock-top) + 6px) !important;}
html[data-vp="phone"] .cmodal-overlay{padding-bottom:calc(var(--i-bottom) + var(--i-size) + 16px);}
html[data-vp="phone"] .cmodal{max-height:calc(100vh - var(--i-bottom) - var(--i-size) - 40px);}

/* ---------- MÀN HÌNH THẤP / ĐIỆN THOẠI XOAY NGANG: tab xếp ngang ---------- */
html[data-short="1"][data-vp="phone"] .bn-item{flex-direction:row;gap:5px;font-size:11px;}
html[data-short="1"][data-vp="phone"] .bn-fab{width:40px;height:40px;transform:none;}
html[data-short="1"][data-vp="phone"] .bn-fab:active{transform:scale(.93);}
html[data-short="1"][data-vp="phone"] .bn-fab span{display:none;}

/* ---------- MÁY TÍNH / MÁY TÍNH BẢNG: thanh menu bên trái chừa đệm đáy cho "i" ---------- */
html:not([data-vp="phone"]) .side-nav{
  padding-bottom:calc(var(--i-bottom) + var(--i-size) + 22px);
}
html:not([data-vp="phone"]) body::after{
  content:"Thông tin ứng dụng";
  position:fixed;
  left:calc(var(--i-left) + var(--i-size) * .5);
  bottom:var(--i-bottom);
  height:var(--i-size);
  max-width:calc(var(--sidenav-w) - var(--i-left) - var(--i-size) * .5 - 6px);
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding:0 12px 0 calc(var(--i-size) * .5 + 12px);
  display:block;
  white-space:nowrap;
  overflow:hidden;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  line-height:calc(var(--i-size) - 2px);
  border-radius:calc(var(--i-size) / 2);
  border:1px solid rgba(92,131,104,.25);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,var(--cream-2));
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(23,58,43,.08);
  font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:700;
  color:var(--forest);
  letter-spacing:.2px;
  z-index:489;
  pointer-events:none;
}
html:not([data-vp="phone"]) body.sidenav-collapsed::after{display:none;}

/* ---------- KHUNG HÓA ĐƠN TRƯỢT TRÁI: nút Đóng / Xuất PDF không nằm dưới "i" ---------- */
#invoicePanel .inv-ft{
  padding:12px 14px max(10px, calc(var(--i-bottom) + var(--i-size) / 2 - 16px)) calc(var(--i-left) + var(--i-size) + 14px);
}

@media print{ body::before,body::after{display:none !important;} }

/* Làm đẹp nhẹ toàn trang */
.hd{box-shadow:0 4px 18px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);}
.hd-title{letter-spacing:.4px;}
.product-card{border-radius:14px;}
.product-card:hover{box-shadow:0 14px 28px -14px rgba(23,58,43,.35);}
.cart-wrap{border-radius:18px;}
.filter-bar,.chart-card,.stat-card,.kpi-card,.tbl-wrap{border-radius:16px;}
.page-hd{box-shadow:0 6px 16px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
.cat-btn{box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(23,58,43,.06);}

/* Máy tính: chữ "i" nằm góc dưới trái, chừa chỗ ở cuối thanh bên */
.side-nav{padding-bottom:56px;}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none !important;animation:none !important;}}

<script id="i-detect">
/* Nhận dạng kích thước + tỷ lệ màn hình, gắn nhãn lên <html> để CSS co giản các khung.
   Bật "Mobile Mode" của trang cũng được tính là điện thoại. */
(function(){
  var de = document.documentElement, raf = 0;
  function nhanDang(){
    var w = window.innerWidth || de.clientWidth || 360;
    var h = window.innerHeight || de.clientHeight || 640;
    var r = w / h;
    var mm = !!(document.body && document.body.classList.contains('mobile-mode'));
    var vp = (mm || w <= 768) ? 'phone' : (w >= 1100 ? 'desktop' : 'tablet');
    var ar = r >= 1.2 ? 'wide' : (r >= 0.8 ? 'square' : (r >= 0.52 ? 'normal' : 'tall'));
    var short = (h < 480 || (ar === 'wide' && h < 560)) ? '1' : '0';
    if(de.getAttribute('data-vp') !== vp) de.setAttribute('data-vp', vp);
    if(de.getAttribute('data-ar') !== ar) de.setAttribute('data-ar', ar);
    if(de.getAttribute('data-short') !== short) de.setAttribute('data-short', short);
  }
  function hoan(){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = requestAnimationFrame(nhanDang); }
  nhanDang();
  window.addEventListener('resize', hoan);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function(){ setTimeout(nhanDang, 250); });
  if(window.visualViewport) window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', hoan);
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
    nhanDang();
    try{ new MutationObserver(hoan).observe(document.body, {attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class']}); }catch(e){}
  });
})();
</script>

<script id="i-cal">
/* Bảng chỉnh khớp nút "i": chạm 3 lần liên tiếp vào logo 9 Sạch để mở */
(function(){
  var de = document.documentElement, KEY = 'i_cal_9sach';
  var DEF = {left:15, bottom:24, size:42};
  var v = {left:DEF.left, bottom:DEF.bottom, size:DEF.size};
  try{
    var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null');
    if(s){ v.left = +s.left || v.left; v.bottom = +s.bottom || v.bottom; v.size = +s.size || v.size; }
  }catch(e){}
  function ap(){
    de.style.setProperty('--i-left', v.left + 'px');
    de.style.setProperty('--i-bottom', v.bottom + 'px');
    de.style.setProperty('--i-size', v.size + 'px');
  }
  function save(){ try{ localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(v)); }catch(e){} }
  ap();

  var panel = null;
  var ROWS = [['left','Cách trái'], ['bottom','Cách đáy'], ['size','Cỡ hộp "i"']];
  var F = "font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;";
  function draw(){
    if(!panel) return;
    var h = '<div style="'+F+'font-weight:800;font-size:13px;color:#173a2b;margin-bottom:10px;">Chỉnh khớp nút "i"</div>';
    ROWS.forEach(function(r){
      h += '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;'+F+'font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;color:#1c2b22;">' +
        '<span style="flex:1;">'+r[1]+'</span>' +
        '<button type="button" data-k="'+r[0]+'" data-d="-1" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;border:1.5px solid #e4e1d4;background:#fff;font-size:18px;">−</button>' +
        '<b style="width:46px;text-align:center;">'+v[r[0]]+'px</b>' +
        '<button type="button" data-k="'+r[0]+'" data-d="1" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;border:1.5px solid #e4e1d4;background:#fff;font-size:18px;">+</button></div>';
    });
    h += '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;">' +
      '<button type="button" data-act="reset" style="flex:1;height:38px;border-radius:11px;border:1.5px solid #e4e1d4;background:#fff;font-size:12.5px;">Đặt lại</button>' +
      '<button type="button" data-act="close" style="flex:1;height:38px;border-radius:11px;border:0;background:#173a2b;color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;">Xong</button></div>' +
      '<div style="'+F+'font-size:11px;color:#6b7a71;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.4;">Chỉnh đến khi đế ôm khít hộp "i" và nằm lọt trong thanh dock. Số được lưu trên thiết bị này.</div>';
    panel.innerHTML = h;
  }
  function open(){
    if(panel) return;
    panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(300px,92vw);background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.30);z-index:100001;';
    panel.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest('button'); if(!b) return;
      if(b.dataset.act === 'close'){ panel.remove(); panel = null; return; }
      if(b.dataset.act === 'reset'){ v = {left:DEF.left, bottom:DEF.bottom, size:DEF.size}; }
      else if(b.dataset.k){ v[b.dataset.k] = Math.max(0, v[b.dataset.k] + Number(b.dataset.d)); }
      ap(); save(); draw();
    });
    document.body.appendChild(panel); draw();
  }
  var taps = 0, timer = null;
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(!e.target.closest || !e.target.closest('.hd-title, #loginLogoImg')) return;
    taps++; clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(function(){ taps = 0; }, 700);
    if(taps >= 3){ taps = 0; open(); }
  }, true);
})();
</script>
</head>

            <svg class="pg-s-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
            <input type="text" id="pgSearchInput" placeholder="Tìm bánh..." autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" autocorrect="off" spellcheck="false" inputmode="search" enterkeyhint="search" aria-label="Tìm sản phẩm" oninput="pgSearchInput(this.value)" onkeydown="pgSearchKey(event)">
            <button type="button" class="pg-s-x" onclick="pgSearchClear()" aria-label="Xóa tìm kiếm">&#10005;</button>
          </div>
          <div class="pg-ord" id="pgOrdBar">
            <button type="button" class="pg-ord-b" id="pgEditBtn" onclick="pgEditToggle()" title="Tự sắp xếp vị trí hiển thị bánh (lưu theo tài khoản, trên thiết bị này)">Sắp xếp bánh</button>
            <button type="button" class="pg-ord-b pg-ord-reset" id="pgResetBtn" onclick="pgOrderReset()" title="Trả về thứ tự mặc định">Mặc định</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="row g-2" id="productGrid"><div class="col-12 text-center py-4 text-muted"><i class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>Đang tải danh mục...</div></div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="cart-wrap">
          <form id="orderForm">
            <div class="cart-scroll">
              <div class="cart-hd-row">
                <h5 class="fw-bold mb-0" style="font-size:15px;color:var(--forest);"><i class="fa fa-shopping-basket me-2"></i>GIỎ HÀNG</h5>
                <button type="button" id="btnBillToggle" class="btn-bill-toggle" onclick="toggleInvoicePanel()"><i class="fa fa-receipt me-1"></i>Xem Bill</button>
              </div>
              <button type="button" id="btnPasteOrder" class="btn-paste-order" onclick="PasteOrderUI.open()"><i class="fa fa-paste"></i>Tạo đơn bằng văn bản (dán chat Zalo)</button>
              <div id="cartItems" class="mb-2"><p class="text-muted text-center py-3 small">Chưa có sản phẩm</p></div>
              <div class="d-flex justify-content-between fw-bold mb-3 py-2 border-top border-bottom" style="font-size:17px;">
                <span>TỔNG CỘNG:</span><span id="totalDisplay" class="text-danger">0đ</span>
              </div>
              <div class="mb-3" id="shipFeeRow" style="margin-top:-6px;">
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2">
                  <label for="cShip" class="small fw-bold mb-0" style="color:var(--forest);"><i class="fa fa-motorcycle me-1"></i>Phụ thu phí vận chuyển <span class="text-muted fw-normal">(nếu có)</span></label>
                  <input type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" id="cShip" class="form-control form-control-sm text-end fw-bold" style="width:118px;" placeholder="0" oninput="formatShipInput(this)">
                </div>
                <div class="form-text" style="font-size:10.5px;margin-top:2px;">Công ty thu hộ / chi hộ: chỉ hiện trên Bill và nội dung gửi kho + kế toán, KHÔNG tính vào tổng đơn &amp; doanh thu.</div>
              </div>
              <div class="cust-header" onclick="toggleCustomerInfo()">
                <span class="fw-bold" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--forest);"><i class="fa fa-user me-1"></i>THÔNG TIN KHÁCH HÀNG</span>
                <i class="fa fa-chevron-up" id="iconToggleCust" style="color:var(--forest);"></i>
              </div>
              <div id="custBody">
                <div class="row g-2 mb-1">
                  <div class="col-12">
                    <div class="addr-wrap">
                      <input type="text" id="cCodeSearch" class="form-control form-control-sm fw-bold" placeholder="Mã khách hàng - gõ để gợi ý (VD: CTMNSG, ĐNMNHN-0001...)" autocomplete="off" style="letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--forest);"
                        oninput="handleCustCodeInput(this.value)" onfocus="handleCustCodeInput(this.value)" onblur="hideCustNameDropdown()">
                      <div id="custCodeDropdown" class="addr-dd"></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="row g-2 mb-1">
                  <div class="col-6"><input type="tel" id="cPhone" class="form-control form-control-sm" oninput="handlePhoneChange(this.value);refreshCustomerCode()" placeholder="Số điện thoại"></div>
                  <div class="col-6">
                    <div class="addr-wrap">
                    <input type="text" id="cName" class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Tên khách hàng" autocomplete="off"
                    oninput="_selCustCode='';_clearCodeSearch();handleCustNameInput(this.value);refreshCustomerCode()" onfocus="handleCustNameInput(this.value)" onblur="hideCustNameDropdown()">
                    <div id="custNameDropdown" class="addr-dd"></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div id="statusHint"></div>
                <div id="areaGroup">
                  <div class="section-title">ĐỊA CHỈ GIAO HÀNG (2 CẤP - SAU SÁP NHẬP)</div>
                  <div class="addr-wrap mb-2"><input type="text" id="cityInput" class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Gõ tên Tỉnh / Thành phố (có/không dấu đều được)..." autocomplete="off" oninput="filterAddr('city')" onfocus="showDropdown('city')" onblur="hideDropdown('city')"><input type="hidden" id="cityCode"><div id="cityDropdown" class="addr-dd"></div></div>
                  <div class="addr-wrap mb-2"><input type="text" id="wardInput" class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Gõ tên Phường / Xã..." autocomplete="off" oninput="filterAddr('ward')" onfocus="showDropdown('ward')" onblur="hideDropdown('ward')" disabled><input type="hidden" id="wardCode"><div id="wardDropdown" class="addr-dd"></div></div>
                </div>
                <input type="text" id="cStreet" class="form-control form-control-sm mb-2" placeholder="Số nhà, tên đường..." oninput="refreshCustomerCode()">
                <div id="newCustWrap" style="display:none;">
                <div class="section-title">KHÁCH MỚI - CẤP MÃ MỚI <a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="cancelNewCustMode()" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--red);font-weight:600;text-transform:none;">(hủy)</a></div>
                <div id="custCodeBox" class="code-box">
                  <div class="row g-2">
                    <div class="col-4"><select id="ccGroup" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="_ccGroupTouched=true;refreshCustomerCode()" title="Nhóm khách"><option value="MN">MN - Sỉ Menu</option><option value="CH">CH - Cửa hàng</option><option value="HCTM">HCTM - Hội chợ TM</option><option value="HCGC">HCGC - Hội chợ GC</option></select></div>
                    <div class="col-3"><select id="ccFactory" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="refreshCustomerCode()" title="Xưởng"><option value="">Xưởng: tự động</option><option value="CT">CT</option><option value="ĐN">ĐN</option></select></div>
                    <div class="col-5"><input type="text" id="custCode" class="form-control form-control-sm fw-bold" readonly placeholder="Chưa đủ thông tin"></div>
                  </div>
                  <div id="custCodeHint" class="form-text" style="font-size:11px;"></div>
                </div>
                </div>
                <div class="section-title">HÓA ĐƠN (NẾU CÓ)</div>
                <div class="row g-2 mb-2">
                <div class="col-6"><input type="text" id="taxCode"     class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Mã số thuế"></div>
                <div class="col-6"><input type="text" id="companyName" class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Tên công ty"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="row g-2 mb-2">
                  <div class="col-7"><input type="text" id="invoiceNameInput" class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Tên xuất hóa đơn"></div>
                  <div class="col-5"><input type="text" id="cccdInput" class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="CCCD (nếu có)"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="section-title">GHI CHÚ ĐƠN</div>
                <textarea id="note" class="form-control form-control-sm mb-1" rows="2" placeholder="Ví dụ: Giao sau 5h chiều..." oninput="syncNoteChips()"></textarea>
                <div id="noteChips" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-2">
                  <button type="button" class="note-chip" data-tok="Có tem" onclick="toggleNoteChip(this)">Có tem</button>
                  <button type="button" class="note-chip" data-tok="Không tem" onclick="toggleNoteChip(this)">Không tem</button>
                  <button type="button" class="note-chip" data-tok="Túi muỗng" onclick="toggleNoteChip(this)">Túi muỗng</button>
                  <button type="button" class="note-chip" data-tok="Thêm đá bi" onclick="toggleNoteChip(this)">Thêm đá bi</button>
                  <button type="button" class="note-chip" data-tok="Cấp đông" onclick="toggleNoteChip(this)">Cấp đông</button>
                </div>
                <div class="mb-1 p-2 rounded" style="background:var(--gold-soft);border:1px solid #efd6a3;">
                  <div class="form-check"><input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="chkDebt"><label class="form-check-label fw-bold small" style="color:var(--gold-deep);" for="chkDebt"><i class="fa fa-file-invoice-dollar me-1"></i>Tạo công nợ cho đơn này</label></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="cart-footer">
              <div class="d-flex gap-2">
                <button type="submit" id="btnSubmit" class="btn btn-success flex-grow-1 fw-bold" disabled style="font-size:14px;border-radius:10px;">XÁC NHẬN ĐƠN HÀNG</button>
                <button type="button" id="btnPrintReceipt" class="btn btn-outline-secondary fw-bold px-3" onclick="printReceipt()" disabled title="Xuất PDF" style="border-radius:10px;"><i class="fa fa-file-pdf"></i></button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PAGE: LỊCH SỬ -->
  <div id="page-history" class="page">
    <div class="page-hd" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#276749,#1a4432);">
      <button class="btn-back" onclick="showPage('order')"><i class="fa fa-arrow-left"></i></button>

      <button class="btn-xls" onclick="exportHistoryExcel()"><i class="fa fa-file-excel me-1"></i>Xuất Excel</button>
      <button class="btn-xls btn-print-x" onclick="printXls(exportHistoryExcel)" title="In trực tiếp"><i class="fa fa-print me-1"></i>In</button>
    </div>
    <div class="page-body">
      <div class="filter-bar">
        <div class="row g-2 align-items-end">

          <div class="col-6 col-md-2"><label class="small fw-bold">Tìm KH / SĐT</label><input type="text" id="hisSearch" class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Nhập..." oninput="debounce(loadHistory,400)()"></div>
          <div class="col-6 col-md-3" id="hisEmpWrap">

            <div class="ms-dd-wrap">
              <button type="button" class="form-select form-select-sm ms-dd-btn" id="hisEmpDropBtn" onclick="toggleHisEmpDropdown()">-- Tất cả nhân viên --</button>
              <div class="ms-dd-panel" id="hisEmpDropPanel" style="display:none;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="col-4 col-md-2"><label class="small fw-bold">Thứ tự</label><select id="hisOrder" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="renderHistory()"><option value="desc">Mới nhất</option><option value="asc">Cũ nhất</option></select></div>
          <div class="col-4 col-md-1"><label class="small fw-bold">&nbsp;</label><button class="btn btn-sm w-100 fw-bold" style="background:#276749;color:#fff;" onclick="loadHistory()"><i class="fa fa-sync"></i></button></div>
        </div>
        <div class="d-flex gap-3 flex-wrap mt-2">

          </div>
          <div class="stat-card px-3 py-2 d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2" style="border-radius:8px;border-left-color:var(--blue);">
            <span class="small text-muted">Số đơn:</span><span id="hisOrderCount" class="fw-bold text-primary">0</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="hisLoading" class="text-center py-4 text-muted" style="display:none;"><i class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>Đang tải...</div>
      <div id="hisCards"></div>
      <div class="tbl-wrap" id="hisTblWrap">
        <table class="table table-sm table-bordered table-hover">
          <thead><tr><th>Ngày đặt</th><th>Khách hàng</th><th>Sản phẩm</th><th class="text-end">SL</th><th class="text-end">Giá trị</th><th>Loại giá</th><th>NV</th><th>Ghi chú</th><th>Thao tác</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody id="hisTbody"><tr><td colspan="9" class="text-center text-muted py-3">Nhấn tải lại để xem</td></tr></tbody>
        </table>

        </div>

      </div>
      <div class="stats-row">
        <div class="stat-card red"><div class="stat-lbl">Tổng doanh thu</div><div class="stat-val red" id="revTotal">0đ</div></div>

    <div class="page-body">
      <div class="filter-bar">

          <div class="col-6 col-md-3"><label class="small fw-bold">&nbsp;</label><button class="btn btn-sm w-100 fw-bold" style="background:#155e75;color:#fff;" onclick="exportSummaryReport()"><i class="fa fa-layer-group me-1"></i>Xuất Báo Cáo Tổng Hợp</button></div>
          <div class="col-6 col-md-2"><label class="small fw-bold">&nbsp;</label><button class="btn btn-sm w-100 fw-bold btn-print-x" style="background:#0e4a5c;color:#fff;" onclick="printXls(exportSummaryReport)"><i class="fa fa-print me-1"></i>In</button></div>
          <div class="col-6 col-md-3"><label class="small fw-bold">&nbsp;</label><button class="btn btn-sm w-100 fw-bold" style="background:var(--forest);color:#fff;" onclick="copyAnalyticsReport()"><i class="fa fa-comment-dots me-1"></i>Copy Báo Cáo Zalo</button></div>
        </div>

    </div>

    <div class="tbl-wrap">
      <table class="table table-sm table-bordered table-hover mb-0">
        <thead><tr><th>Giờ tạo</th><th>Khách hàng</th><th>Số điện thoại</th><th class="text-end">Số lượng</th><th class="text-end">Doanh thu</th><th>Người tạo</th><th class="text-center">Trạng thái</th><th>Người duyệt</th><th>Thời gian duyệt</th></tr></thead>
