  dome(-0.62, 0.02, 0.27, '#4a3024', 'almond', 0.6, 0.85);                         // choco hạnh nhân
  const mg = new T.Mesh(X.geo(softBox(T, 0.36, 0.17, 0.36, 3.2)), skinMat('#6f9f3f', 'none', 0.8)); cup(-0.12, -0.2, 0.24); add(mg, -0.12, 0.17, -0.2);   // matcha vuông bo góc
  const petal = X.mat('ktc-petal', { color: '#ffffff', roughness: 0.5 }); for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { const a = k / 6 * TAU; const p = new T.Mesh(X.geo(new T.SphereGeometry(0.04, 12, 8)), petal); p.scale.set(1.3, 0.6, 1); p.position.set(-0.12 + Math.cos(a) * 0.06, 0.275, -0.2 + Math.sin(a) * 0.06); p.rotation.y = -a; g.add(p); }
  const cb = new T.Mesh(X.geo(softBox(T, 0.26, 0.22, 0.26, 3.4)), X.mat('ktc-cube', { color: '#fff6e4', roughness: 0.5 })); add(cb, -0.08, 0.13, 0.26).rotation.y = 0.5;   // khối kem trắng
  add(new T.Mesh(X.geo(new T.SphereGeometry(0.04, 12, 8)), X.mat('ktc-chip', { color: '#3b1d12', roughness: 0.4 })), -0.08, 0.25, 0.26);
  cup(0.24, -0.2, 0.17); const bb = X.mat('ktc-berry', { color: '#3a1d3f', roughness: 0.28 });
  [[0, 0, 0], [0.09, 0.03, 0.02], [-0.07, 0.07, 0.01], [0.03, 0.1, 0.06], [-0.03, -0.07, 0.06], [0.1, -0.05, 0.07], [0.0, 0.03, 0.12]].forEach((q) => add(new T.Mesh(X.geo(new T.SphereGeometry(0.075, 16, 12)), bb), 0.24 + q[0], 0.17 + q[2], -0.2 + q[1]));   // cụm mâm xôi
  dome(0.64, 0.04, 0.29, '#fbf1dc', 'coconut', 0.7, 0.85);                         // kem phô mai + hạnh nhân lát
  const am = X.mat('ktc-alm', { color: '#ead7ae', roughness: 0.7 }); for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { const sl = new T.Mesh(X.geo(new T.BoxGeometry(0.11, 0.014, 0.05)), am); sl.rotation.set(0.35, k * 1.0, 0.3); add(sl, 0.64 + Math.sin(k * 1.1) * 0.1, 0.36 - Math.abs(Math.sin(k * 1.1)) * 0.05, 0.04 + Math.cos(k * 1.1) * 0.1); }
  return { g, anim: null };
}
GIFT.ktc = buildKtc;
function pdGiftKey(n) {     // n đã norm — hàng tặng / quà (khớp giftKey của Kết ca, thêm các loại trái cây sấy)
  if (/\bktc\b|kem (socola|so co la|chocolate|sô cô la)|socola trai cay|khay|combo|sampler|tong hop/.test(n)) return 'ktc';
  if (/sua chua|pho mai/.test(n)) return 'scpm'; if (/tui giu/.test(n)) return 'tui'; if (/moc khoa/.test(n)) return 'mockhoa';
  if (/trai cay say|xoai|mang cau|khom|thom say|say deo|mit say|chuoi say/.test(n)) return 'traicay'; return '';
}
function keyOf(p) {
  const name = String((p && p.name) || ''), det = String((p && p.detailName) || ''), cat = String((p && p.category) || '');
  const own = norm(name + ' ' + det);
  if (/\bktc\b|kem (socola|so co la|chocolate)|socola trai cay|\bkhay\b|combo|sampler|tong hop/.test(own)) { PD_REG.set('g|ktc', { type: 'gift', k: 'ktc' }); return 'g|ktc'; }
  let kind = pdKind(name + ' ' + det); if (kind === 'other') kind = pdKind(cat);
  if (kind === 'other' && /\bpsx\b|\bps\b|choco|socola|hanh nhan|than tre|than hoat|khoai mon|\btim\b|taro|la dua/.test(own)) kind = 'phusi';
  if (kind === 'other' && /\bvang\b/.test(own) && /banh|sau rieng/.test(own)) kind = 'truyenthong';
  const isBanh = /\bbanh\b|sau rieng|crepe|phu si|lava|ngan lop|3 vi|truyen thong/.test(own);
  if (!isBanh && /panna|cotta/.test(own)) { const d = { kind: 'other', name: name, text: cat + ' ' + name + ' ' + det }; PD_REG.set('c|panna|' + own, { type: 'cake', d }); return 'c|panna|' + own; }
  if (!isBanh) { const gk = pdGiftKey(own); if (gk) { PD_REG.set('g|' + gk, { type: 'gift', k: gk }); return 'g|' + gk; } }
  if (kind === 'other' && !isBanh) return '';   // không phải bánh → giữ ảnh cũ
  const d = { kind: kind, name: name, text: cat + ' ' + name + ' ' + det };
  const key = 'c|' + kind + '|' + norm(d.text); PD_REG.set(key, { type: 'cake', d }); return key;
}

function mountProducts(T) {
  const track = [], X = mkTools(T, track);
  const renderer = new T.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true, powerPreference: 'low-power' });
  renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0); renderer.outputColorSpace = T.SRGBColorSpace; renderer.toneMapping = T.ACESFilmicToneMapping; renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;
  const scene = new T.Scene(), cam = new T.PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 0.1, 60);
  const key = new T.DirectionalLight('#fff3dc', 2.6); key.position.set(3, 5, 4); const fill = new T.DirectionalLight('#cfe6ff', 0.9); fill.position.set(-4, 2, 3);
  scene.add(key, fill, new T.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xe8dcc0, 1.1));   // đúng bộ đèn của tủ bánh Kết ca
  try {
    const pm = new T.PMREMGenerator(renderer), es = new T.Scene(), ec = document.createElement('canvas'); ec.width = 16; ec.height = 256;
    const ex = ec.getContext('2d'), gr = ex.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 256); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff6e4'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffffff'); gr.addColorStop(1, '#d8ccb2'); ex.fillStyle = gr; ex.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 256);
    const et = new T.CanvasTexture(ec); et.colorSpace = T.SRGBColorSpace; es.add(new T.Mesh(new T.SphereGeometry(10, 32, 16), new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: et, side: T.BackSide })));
    [[3, 5, 4, 4, 2.5], [-4, 3, 3, 3, 2], [0, 6, -3, 5, 2]].forEach((b) => { const sb = new T.Mesh(new T.PlaneGeometry(b[3], b[4]), new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ side: T.DoubleSide })); sb.material.color.setRGB(4, 4, 4); sb.position.set(b[0], b[1], b[2]); sb.lookAt(0, 0, 0); es.add(sb); });
    const rt = pm.fromScene(es, 0.04); scene.environment = rt.texture; scene.environmentIntensity = 0.3; X.envBox.tex = rt.texture; track.push(rt, et); pm.dispose();
  } catch (e) { /* không có môi trường thì dùng đèn thường */ }
  const shTex = (() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 64; const x = c.getContext('2d'), gr = x.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(14,48,30,.7)'); gr.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(14,48,30,.28)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(14,48,30,0)'); x.fillStyle = gr; x.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64); const t = new T.CanvasTexture(c); track.push(t); return t; })();
  const shadow = new T.Mesh(new T.PlaneGeometry(1, 1), new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: shTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false })); shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; scene.add(shadow); track.push(shadow.geometry, shadow.material);
  const models = new Map(), bad = new Set(); let dead = false, run = false, raf = 0, lastDraw = 0, W = 0, Hh = 0, errs = 0, lost = false, fails = 0, rr = 0;
  renderer.domElement.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); lost = true; });
  renderer.domElement.addEventListener('webglcontextrestored', () => { lost = false; });
  function zoomOf(reg) {   // mọi sản phẩm to, gần đầy khung; bánh 16cm lớn hơn 12cm
    if (reg.type !== 'cake') return 0.98;
    const mm = /(\d+)\s*cm/.exec(norm(reg.d.text)); if (!mm) return 0.98;
    return clamp(0.92 * Math.pow(+mm[1] / 12, 0.6), 0.78, 1.04);
  }
  function get(k) {
    let m = models.get(k); if (m) return m; if (bad.has(k)) return null; const reg = PD_REG.get(k); if (!reg) return null;
    let r;
    try {
      if (reg.type === 'gift') { const b = GIFT[reg.k]; if (!b) { bad.add(k); return null; } r = b(T, X); }
      else { const c = buildCake(T, X, reg.d); r = { g: c.obj, anim: null }; }
    } catch (e) { bad.add(k); try { console.warn('PD3D: không dựng được mô hình', k, e && e.message); } catch (_) {} return null; }
    const wrap = new T.Group(), pivot = new T.Group(); wrap.add(r.g); pivot.add(wrap); scene.add(pivot); if (r.anim) r.anim(0);
    pivot.updateMatrixWorld(true); const bx = new T.Box3().setFromObject(r.g), c = bx.getCenter(new T.Vector3()); wrap.position.set(-c.x, -c.y, -c.z); pivot.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    let hr = 0; [bx.min.x, bx.max.x].forEach((x) => [bx.min.z, bx.max.z].forEach((z) => { hr = Math.max(hr, Math.hypot(x - c.x, z - c.z)); }));
    m = { pivot, anim: r.anim, halfH: (bx.max.y - bx.min.y) / 2, hr, ph: models.size * 1.7, el: (r.g.userData && r.g.userData.el) || (reg.type === 'cake' ? 0.5 : 0.3), zoom: zoomOf(reg) * ((r.g.userData && r.g.userData.zoom) || 1) }; pivot.visible = false; models.set(k, m); return m;
  }
  function draw(cv, t) {
    const m = get(cv.dataset.g); if (!m) return;
    const bb = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); if (bb.width < 8 || bb.height < 8 || bb.bottom < -60 || bb.top > innerHeight + 60) return;
    const dp = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, cv.classList.contains('pd-big') ? 3 : 2.5), w = Math.round(bb.width * dp), h = Math.round(bb.height * dp);
    if (cv.width !== w || cv.height !== h) { cv.width = w; cv.height = h; }
    if (W !== w || Hh !== h) { renderer.setSize(w, h, false); W = w; Hh = h; cam.aspect = w / h; cam.updateProjectionMatrix(); }
    models.forEach((o) => { o.pivot.visible = o === m; });
    if (cv.classList.contains('pd-big')) { if (!cv._drag) cv._ry = (cv._ry || 0) + 0.006; m.pivot.rotation.y = m.ph + (cv._ry || 0); } else m.pivot.rotation.y = t * 0.32 + m.ph; m.pivot.position.y = Math.sin(t * 0.9 + m.ph) * 0.025 * m.halfH; if (m.anim) m.anim(t);
    const tn = Math.tan(T.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov / 2)), dist = (Math.max(m.halfH / tn, m.hr / (tn * cam.aspect)) + m.hr * 0.03) / (m.zoom * (cv._zm || 1)), el = (cv._el != null ? cv._el : m.el); cv._elCur = el;
    cam.position.set(0, Math.sin(el) * dist, Math.cos(el) * dist); cam.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
    shadow.position.set(0, -m.halfH - 0.01, 0); shadow.scale.set(m.hr * 2.7, m.hr * 2.7, 1);
    renderer.render(scene, cam);
    const x2 = cv.getContext('2d'); x2.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); x2.drawImage(renderer.domElement, 0, 0, w, h);
    const pr = cv.parentNode; if (pr && !pr.classList.contains('g3')) pr.classList.add('g3');
  }
  let budget = 6;
  function frame(now) {
    if (dead) return;
    const cvs = document.querySelectorAll('canvas.pd-3d');
    if (!cvs.length) { run = false; return; }   // không còn ô nào → nghỉ; trang gọi start() lại khi vẽ lại lưới
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    if (lost || document.hidden) return;
    const t0 = performance.now(), vis = [], bigCv = document.querySelector('canvas.pd-3d.pd-big');
    if (bigCv) vis.push(bigCv); else cvs.forEach((cv) => { const bb = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); if (bb.width >= 8 && bb.height >= 8 && bb.bottom >= -60 && bb.top <= innerHeight + 60) vis.push(cv); });
    const n = vis.length; if (!n) return;
    try {
      const b = Math.min(n, budget);   // vẽ mỗi nhịp (tới 60 khung/giây); tự giảm số ô/nhịp nếu máy yếu → vẫn mượt
      for (let i = 0; i < b; i++) draw(vis[(rr + i) % n], now / 1000);
      rr = (rr + b) % n; errs = 0;
    } catch (e) {
      errs++; try { console.warn('PD3D lỗi:', e && e.message); } catch (_) {}
      if (errs > 3) { fails = 1; dead = true; run = false; cvs.forEach((cv) => { const pr = cv.parentNode; if (pr) pr.classList.remove('g3'); cv.remove(); }); }
    }
    const dt = performance.now() - t0; if (dt > 14) budget = Math.max(2, budget - 1); else if (dt < 7 && budget < 24) budget++;
  }
  function dispose() { dead = true; run = false; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); track.forEach((t) => { try { t.dispose && t.dispose(); } catch (e) {} }); try { renderer.dispose(); } catch (e) {} }
  return { start() { if (dead || run) return; run = true; raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }, dispose, failed() { return fails === 1; }, keyOf };
}

window.PD3D = { mountProducts: mountProducts, keyOf: keyOf, CFG: CFG };

</script>
<script id="pd3d-glue">
/* =====================================================================
   9 SẠCH — TĐKS · ẢNH SẢN PHẨM 3D XOAY (bản 20261028-pd3d)
   • Chỉ thay phần HÌNH trong ô sản phẩm (initGrid). Bấm ô để thêm vào giỏ, huy hiệu số lượng, nút sửa, nhãn danh mục... giữ nguyên.
   • Sản phẩm chưa có mô hình 3D, không có WebGL, hoặc Three.js tải lỗi → ô giữ ảnh cũ / chữ cái như trước.
   • Mô hình dùng chung với trang Kết ca (module #pd3d-module phía trên).
   • Tắt khẩn cấp: nút "3D" cạnh bộ lọc danh mục, hoặc localStorage pd3d_off = 1.
   ===================================================================== */
var PD = { T: null, mod: null, G: null, pm: null, failed: false, gl: undefined, build: '20261028-pd3d' };
var PD_CDN = ['https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.164.1/build/three.module.js', 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.164.1/build/three.module.js', 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.164.1/three.module.min.js'];
function pdOff() { try { return localStorage.getItem('pd3d_off') === '1'; } catch (e) { return false; } }
function pdWebgl() {
  if (PD.gl !== undefined) return PD.gl;
  try {
    var c = document.createElement('canvas'), g = c.getContext('webgl2') || c.getContext('webgl'); PD.gl = !!(window.WebGLRenderingContext && g);
    try { var x = g && g.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context'); if (x) x.loseContext(); } catch (e) {}
  } catch (e) { PD.gl = false; }
  return PD.gl;
}
function pdWant() { return !PD.failed && !pdOff() && pdWebgl(); }
function pdLoad() {
  if (PD.pm) return PD.pm;
  var modP = new Promise(function (ok, no) {
    var t0 = Date.now(), iv = setInterval(function () {
      if (window.PD3D) { clearInterval(iv); ok(window.PD3D); } else if (Date.now() - t0 > 30000) { clearInterval(iv); no(new Error('module 3D chưa nạp')); }
    }, 80);
  });
  var three = Promise.reject(new Error('x'));
  PD_CDN.forEach(function (u) { three = three.catch(function () { return import(u); }); });
  PD.pm = Promise.race([Promise.all([three, modP]), new Promise(function (_, no) { setTimeout(function () { no(new Error('timeout')); }, 30000); })])
    .then(function (a) { PD.T = a[0]; PD.mod = a[1]; PD.G = PD.mod.mountProducts(PD.T); });
  PD.pm.catch(function (e) {
    PD.pm = null; PD.failed = true;
    try { console.warn('PD3D: ảnh sản phẩm 3D không chạy được → dùng ảnh thường:', e && e.message); } catch (_) {}
    try { pdClear(); } catch (_) {}
  });
  return PD.pm;
}
function pdClear() {
  document.querySelectorAll('canvas.pd-3d').forEach(function (c) { var p = c.parentNode; if (p) p.classList.remove('g3'); c.remove(); });
}
function pdDecorate() {
  if (!pdWant()) return;
  var grid = document.getElementById('productGrid'); if (!grid || !grid.querySelector('.product-img-wrap')) return;
  if (!PD.G) { pdLoad().then(pdDecorate).catch(function () {}); return; }
  if (PD.G.failed()) { PD.failed = true; pdClear(); return; }
  var list = pgListNow();
  var wraps = grid.querySelectorAll('.product-img-wrap'), n = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < wraps.length && i < list.length; i++) {
    if (wraps[i].querySelector('canvas.pd-3d')) continue;
    var k = ''; try { k = PD.mod.keyOf(list[i]); } catch (e) { k = ''; }
    if (!k) continue;
    var cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.className = 'pd-3d'; cv.setAttribute('data-g', k); wraps[i].appendChild(cv); n++;
  }
  PD.G.start();
}
/* ---- Sản phẩm đã xóa không hiện lại: máy chủ có thể còn trả danh sách cũ (cache) nên ghi nhớ id đã xóa 30 phút ---- */
var PD_DEL_KEY = 'pd_deleted_sp', PD_DEL_TTL = 30 * 60 * 1000;
function pdDeleted() {
  var o = {}; try { o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PD_DEL_KEY) || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) { o = {}; }
  var now = Date.now(), k, ch = false; for (k in o) { if (now - o[k] > PD_DEL_TTL) { delete o[k]; ch = true; } }
  if (ch) { try { localStorage.setItem(PD_DEL_KEY, JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (e) {} }
  return o;
}
function pdMarkDeleted(id) {
  var o = pdDeleted(); o[String(id)] = Date.now(); try { localStorage.setItem(PD_DEL_KEY, JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (e) {}
  try { var c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sys9sach_cache') || 'null'); if (c && c.products) { c.products = c.products.filter(function (p) { return String(p.id) !== String(id); }); localStorage.setItem('sys9sach_cache', JSON.stringify(c)); } } catch (e) {}
}
function pdDropDeleted() { var o = pdDeleted(); products = (products || []).filter(function (p) { return !o[String(p.id)]; }); }
var _initGrid3d = initGrid;
initGrid = function () { try { pdDropDeleted(); } catch (e) {} _initGrid3d.apply(this, arguments); try { pdDecorate(); } catch (e) {} };
deleteProduct = function () {
  if (!confirm('Xác nhận xóa sản phẩm này?')) return;
  var id = document.getElementById('spId').value;
  showProgress('Đang xóa...');
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function (msg) {
    doneProgress(); showToast(msg, 'success'); hideModal('productModal');
    if (cart[id]) delete cart[id];
    pdMarkDeleted(id); products = (products || []).filter(function (p) { return String(p.id) !== String(id); }); initGrid(); updateCart();   // biến mất ngay
    reloadProductsOnly();
  }).deleteProductFromSheet(id);
};
function pdToggle() {
  var on = pdOff();   // đang tắt → bật
  try { localStorage.setItem('pd3d_off', on ? '0' : '1'); } catch (e) {}
  if (!on) pdClear();
  try { renderCategoryFilters(); } catch (e) {}
  if (on) { try { initGrid(); } catch (e) {} }
}
var _renderCatFilters3d = renderCategoryFilters;
renderCategoryFilters = function () {
  _renderCatFilters3d.apply(this, arguments);
  try {
    if (!pdWebgl() || PD.failed) return;
    var bar = document.getElementById('catFilterBar'); if (!bar) return;
    bar.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<button type="button" class="cat-btn' + (pdOff() ? '' : ' active') + '" id="pdToggle" title="Bật / tắt ảnh sản phẩm 3D xoay" onclick="pdToggle()">3D ' + (pdOff() ? 'tắt' : 'bật') + '</button>');
  } catch (e) {}
};
</script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="pin-size-css">
/* ===== Ghim bảng giá ===== */
.pin-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:stretch;}
.pin-row select{flex:1;min-width:0;}
#btnPinPrice{border:2px solid var(--gold-deep);background:#fff;color:var(--gold-deep);border-radius:9px;font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;padding:0 12px;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;}
#btnPinPrice:hover{background:var(--gold-soft);}
#btnPinPrice.pinned{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;border-color:var(--gold);}
#pinPriceHint{margin-top:6px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--gold-deep);font-weight:700;}
#pinPriceHint a{color:var(--forest);text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;margin-left:6px;}

/* ===== Lưới sản phẩm: ô to hơn để thấy rõ 3D (Nhỏ / Vừa / Lớn, mặc định Lớn) ===== */
#productGrid{display:grid !important;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(var(--pg-min,165px),1fr));gap:10px;margin:0 !important;--bs-gutter-x:0;--bs-gutter-y:0;}
#productGrid>[class*="col-"]{width:auto !important;max-width:none !important;padding:0 !important;margin:0 !important;}
#productGrid>.col-12{grid-column:1/-1;}
#productGrid[data-sz="s"]{--pg-min:105px;}
#productGrid[data-sz="m"]{--pg-min:140px;}
#productGrid[data-sz="l"]{--pg-min:165px;}
@media(min-width:992px){
  #productGrid[data-sz="s"]{--pg-min:150px;}
  #productGrid[data-sz="m"]{--pg-min:200px;}
  #productGrid[data-sz="l"]{--pg-min:270px;}
}
#productGrid[data-sz="m"] .product-name{font-size:13px;}
#productGrid[data-sz="m"] .product-price{font-size:14px;}
#productGrid[data-sz="l"] .product-name{font-size:14.5px;}
#productGrid[data-sz="l"] .product-detail{font-size:11.5px;}
#productGrid[data-sz="l"] .product-price{font-size:16.5px;}
#productGrid[data-sz="l"] .product-cat-tag{font-size:10px;padding:3px 9px;}
.pd-zoom{position:absolute;right:6px;bottom:6px;z-index:11;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);color:var(--forest);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28);font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:.15s;}
.pd-zoom:hover{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;transform:scale(1.1);}

/* ===== Khung xem chi tiết sản phẩm (kéo để xoay) ===== */
#pdvOverlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,24,18,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:2200;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;}
#pdvOverlay.open{display:flex;}
#pdvBox{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;width:100%;max-width:620px;max-height:96vh;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.45);}
#pdvStage{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;max-height:62vh;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%,#f7fcf8 0%,#e2f2e8 55%,#cde6d7 100%);border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;overflow:hidden;margin:0 auto;}
#pdvStage img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block;}
#pdvStage canvas.pd-big{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;z-index:2;}
#pdvStage canvas.pd-big:active{cursor:grabbing;}
.pdv-nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:5;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.28);font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--forest);font-weight:800;}
.pdv-nav.l{left:8px;} .pdv-nav.r{right:8px;}
.pdv-x{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;z-index:6;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.28);font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;}
.pdv-zm{position:absolute;left:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:6;display:flex;gap:6px;}
.pdv-zm button{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);font-size:17px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;color:var(--forest);}
.pdv-hint{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;z-index:6;font-size:11px;color:#3d5a4d;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:12px;}
#pdvInfo{padding:12px 16px 16px;text-align:center;}
#pdvName{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);}
#pdvDetail{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray);margin-top:2px;}
#pdvPrice{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--red);margin:6px 0 10px;}
#pdvInfo .pdv-add{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;background:var(--grad-brand,var(--forest));color:#fff;cursor:pointer;}

/* ===== Khung poster 9 Sạch: nền vàng nhạt + logo + chữ thương hiệu + tên bánh, bánh 3D xoay trong khung ===== */
.product-img-wrap.g3,.product-img-wrap.pdp,#pdvStage{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#fffbe3 0%,#fff1b3 52%,#ffe17f 100%) !important;}
.product-img-wrap.pdp{aspect-ratio:5/6 !important;container-type:inline-size;}
#pdvStage.pdp{container-type:inline-size;}
.pdp .pdp-logo{position:absolute;left:4%;top:3%;width:17%;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(80,50,0,.3));}
.pdp .pdp-brand{position:absolute;left:25%;top:3%;width:56%;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;}
.pdp .pdp-name{position:absolute;left:3%;right:3%;top:19%;text-align:center;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;line-height:1.03;font-family:'Baloo 2','Lilita One','Be Vietnam Pro',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;}
.pdp .pdp-name span{display:block;paint-order:stroke fill;}
.pdp .pdp-name .l1{font-size:8.4cqw;color:#1f8f2e;-webkit-text-stroke:1.1cqw #fff8dc;text-shadow:0 .7cqw 0 #0f5d1e;}
.pdp .pdp-name .l2{color:#ff9d1a;-webkit-text-stroke:1.1cqw #fff8dc;text-shadow:0 .7cqw 0 #c96a00;}
.pdp .pdp-name .l2.s1{font-size:12cqw;} .pdp .pdp-name .l2.s2{font-size:9cqw;} .pdp .pdp-name .l2.s3{font-size:6.8cqw;}
.pdp .pdp-size{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:4%;z-index:3;background:#fff;border:.8cqw solid #1f8f2e;color:#1f8f2e;font-family:'Baloo 2','Lilita One',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:5.4cqw;padding:.4cqw 4cqw;border-radius:4cqw;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;}
.product-img-wrap.pdp canvas.pd-3d{top:35%;height:65%;}
.product-img-wrap.pdp .btn-edit-sp{top:auto;bottom:5px;left:5px;}
.product-img-wrap.pdp .product-cat-tag{display:none;}
#productGrid[data-sz="s"] .pdp-size{display:none;}
#productGrid[data-sz="s"] .pdp .pdp-name .l1{display:none;}
#pdvStage.pdp canvas.pd-big{top:32%;height:68%;}
</style>
<script id="pin-size-glue">
/* =====================================================================
   9 SẠCH — TĐKS · (1) GHIM BẢNG GIÁ  (2) Ô SẢN PHẨM 3D TO + KHUNG XEM CHI TIẾT
   (1) Ghim lưu theo từng nhân viên trên trình duyệt/thiết bị đang dùng (localStorage).
       Lần đầu vào web (hoặc F5) hệ thống tự chọn bảng giá đã ghim. Không đổi chữ trong ô chọn giá
       (vì "Loại giá" của đơn được lưu theo chữ đó).
   ===================================================================== */
var PIN_KEY_PREFIX = 'sys9sach_pinPrice_';
function pinKey() { var u = ''; try { u = (currentEmployee && (currentEmployee.username || currentEmployee.displayName)) || ''; } catch (e) {} return PIN_KEY_PREFIX + u; }
function pinGet() {
  var v = ''; try { v = localStorage.getItem(pinKey()) || ''; } catch (e) {}
  if (!v) return '';
  var sel = document.getElementById('priceKey'); if (!sel) return '';
  for (var i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) if (sel.options[i].value === v) return v;
  return '';
}
function pinText(v) { var sel = document.getElementById('priceKey'); if (!sel) return v; for (var i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) if (sel.options[i].value === v) return sel.options[i].text; return v; }
function pinRender() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('btnPinPrice'), hint = document.getElementById('pinPriceHint'), sel = document.getElementById('priceKey');
  if (!btn || !sel) return;
  var pinned = pinGet(), cur = sel.value;
  if (pinned && pinned === cur) { btn.className = 'pinned'; btn.innerHTML = '📌 Đã ghim'; btn.title = 'Bấm để bỏ ghim'; }
  else { btn.className = ''; btn.innerHTML = '📌 Ghim'; btn.title = 'Ghim bảng giá đang chọn làm mặc định khi mở web'; }
  if (!hint) return;
  if (pinned && pinned !== cur) {
    hint.style.display = ''; hint.innerHTML = '📌 Mặc định khi mở web: <b></b><a onclick="pinUse()">Dùng bảng này</a>';
    hint.querySelector('b').textContent = pinText(pinned);
  } else hint.style.display = 'none';
}
function pinToggle() {
  var sel = document.getElementById('priceKey'); if (!sel) return;
  var cur = sel.value, pinned = pinGet();
  try {
    if (pinned === cur) { localStorage.removeItem(pinKey()); showToast('Đã bỏ ghim bảng giá', 'success'); }
    else { localStorage.setItem(pinKey(), cur); showToast('Đã ghim: ' + pinText(cur) + ' — lần sau vào web sẽ tự dùng bảng giá này', 'success'); }
  } catch (e) { showToast('Trình duyệt không cho lưu ghim (chế độ riêng tư?)', 'error'); }
  pinRender();
}
function pinUse() { var p = pinGet(), sel = document.getElementById('priceKey'); if (!p || !sel) return; sel.value = p; changePriceMode(); }
var _pinApplied = false;
function pinApplyOnce() {
  if (_pinApplied) return;
  var ok = false; try { ok = !!(currentEmployee && (currentEmployee.username || currentEmployee.displayName)); } catch (e) {}
  if (!ok) return;           // chưa đăng nhập → đợi lần initGrid sau
  _pinApplied = true;
  var p = pinGet(), sel = document.getElementById('priceKey'); if (!p || !sel) return;
  sel.value = p; priceMode = p;
  try { _syncCodeGroupFromPrice(); } catch (e) {}
}
var _cpmPin = changePriceMode;
changePriceMode = function () { _cpmPin.apply(this, arguments); try { pinRender(); } catch (e) {}; };

/* ---- (2) cỡ ô sản phẩm ---- */
var PG_SIZES = [['s', 'Nhỏ'], ['m', 'Vừa'], ['l', 'Lớn']];
function pgSize() { var v = 'l'; try { v = localStorage.getItem('pg_size') || 'l'; } catch (e) {} return ('slm'.indexOf(v) >= 0 && v) ? v : 'l'; }
function pgSizeName(v) { for (var i = 0; i < PG_SIZES.length; i++) if (PG_SIZES[i][0] === v) return PG_SIZES[i][1]; return 'Lớn'; }
function pgApplySize() { var g = document.getElementById('productGrid'); if (g) g.setAttribute('data-sz', pgSize()); }
function pgSizeCycle() {
  var cur = pgSize(), idx = 0; for (var i = 0; i < PG_SIZES.length; i++) if (PG_SIZES[i][0] === cur) idx = i;
  var nx = PG_SIZES[(idx + 1) % PG_SIZES.length][0];
  try { localStorage.setItem('pg_size', nx); } catch (e) {}
  pgApplySize(); try { renderCategoryFilters(); } catch (e) {}
  if (typeof pdDecorate === 'function') { try { pdDecorate(); } catch (e) {} }
}
var _renderCatPg = renderCategoryFilters;
renderCategoryFilters = function () {
  _renderCatPg.apply(this, arguments);
  try { var bar = document.getElementById('catFilterBar'); if (bar) bar.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<button type="button" class="cat-btn" id="pgSizeBtn" title="Đổi cỡ ô sản phẩm" onclick="pgSizeCycle()">Ô: ' + pgSizeName(pgSize()) + '</button>'); } catch (e) {}
};

/* ---- nút phóng to trên từng ô + khung xem chi tiết ---- */
function pdListNow() { return pgListNow(); }
function pdAddZoomBtns() {
  var grid = document.getElementById('productGrid'); if (!grid) return;
  var wraps = grid.querySelectorAll('.product-img-wrap'), n = pdListNow().length;
  for (var i = 0; i < wraps.length && i < n; i++) {
    if (wraps[i].querySelector('.pd-zoom')) continue;
    var b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'pd-zoom'; b.title = 'Xem chi tiết / xoay 3D';
    b.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-magnifying-glass-plus"></i>'; b.setAttribute('data-i', i);
    b.onclick = function (ev) { ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault(); pdvOpen(+this.getAttribute('data-i')); };
    wraps[i].appendChild(b);
  }
}
var PDV = { list: [], idx: -1, cv: null };
function pdvEnsure() {
  if (document.getElementById('pdvOverlay')) return;
  var o = document.createElement('div'); o.id = 'pdvOverlay';
  o.innerHTML = '<div id="pdvBox"><div id="pdvStage"></div><div id="pdvInfo"><div id="pdvName"></div><div id="pdvDetail"></div><div id="pdvPrice"></div><button type="button" class="pdv-add" onclick="pdvAdd()">+ Thêm vào giỏ</button></div></div>';
  o.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === o) pdvClose(); });
  document.body.appendChild(o);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (!o.classList.contains('open')) return; if (e.key === 'Escape') pdvClose(); else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') pdvStep(-1); else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') pdvStep(1); });
}
function pdvOpen(i) { pdvEnsure(); PDV.list = pdListNow(); PDV.idx = i; document.getElementById('pdvOverlay').classList.add('open'); pdvRender(); }
function pdvClose() {
  var o = document.getElementById('pdvOverlay'); if (o) o.classList.remove('open');
  var st = document.getElementById('pdvStage'); if (st) st.innerHTML = ''; PDV.cv = null;
}
function pdvStep(d) { if (!PDV.list.length) return; PDV.idx = (PDV.idx + d + PDV.list.length) % PDV.list.length; pdvRender(); }
function pdvAdd() {
  var p = PDV.list[PDV.idx]; if (!p) return; addToCart(p.id);
  try { showToast('Đã thêm ' + p.name + ' (SL: ' + (cart[p.id] || 0) + ')', 'success'); } catch (e) {}
}
function pdvRender() {
  var p = PDV.list[PDV.idx]; if (!p) return;
  var st = document.getElementById('pdvStage'); st.innerHTML = ''; st.className = ''; PDV.cv = null;
  document.getElementById('pdvName').textContent = p.name;
  document.getElementById('pdvDetail').textContent = p.detailName || '';
  document.getElementById('pdvPrice').textContent = (p[priceMode] || 0).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'đ';
  var ui = '<button type="button" class="pdv-x" onclick="pdvClose()">✕</button>'
    + '<button type="button" class="pdv-nav l" onclick="pdvStep(-1)">‹</button><button type="button" class="pdv-nav r" onclick="pdvStep(1)">›</button>';
  var key = '';
  if (pdWant() && PD.G && PD.mod) { try { key = PD.mod.keyOf(p); } catch (e) { key = ''; } }
  if (key) {
    var cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.className = 'pd-3d pd-big'; cv.setAttribute('data-g', key); st.appendChild(cv); PDV.cv = cv; pdpBuild(st, p);
    var sx = 0, sy = 0, ry0 = 0, el0 = 0.5;
    cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { cv._drag = 1; sx = e.clientX; sy = e.clientY; ry0 = cv._ry || 0; el0 = cv._elCur != null ? cv._elCur : 0.5; try { cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {} });
    cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (!cv._drag) return; cv._ry = ry0 + (e.clientX - sx) * 0.012; cv._el = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(1.3, el0 + (e.clientY - sy) * 0.008)); });
    var up = function () { cv._drag = 0; }; cv.addEventListener('pointerup', up); cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
    cv.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); cv._zm = Math.max(0.6, Math.min(2.4, (cv._zm || 1) * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9))); }, { passive: false });
    ui += '<div class="pdv-zm"><button type="button" onclick="pdvZoom(1.2)">+</button><button type="button" onclick="pdvZoom(0.83)">−</button></div><div class="pdv-hint">Kéo để xoay · cuộn để phóng</div>';
    st.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', ui); PD.G.start();
  } else {
    if (p.img) st.innerHTML = '<img src="' + String(p.img).replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + '" alt="">';
    st.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', ui);
    if (pdWant() && !PD.G) { pdLoad().then(function () { if (document.getElementById('pdvOverlay').classList.contains('open')) pdvRender(); }).catch(function () {}); }
  }
}
function pdvZoom(f) { if (PDV.cv) PDV.cv._zm = Math.max(0.6, Math.min(2.4, (PDV.cv._zm || 1) * f)); }


/* ---- khung poster: logo + chữ thương hiệu + tên bánh (nền của ô), bánh 3D xoay phía trước ---- */
var PDP_WM = "data:image/webp;base64,", PDP_LOGO = "data:image/webp;base64,";
function pdpTexts(p) {
  var raw = String((p && (p.detailName || p.name)) || '').normalize('NFC');
  var mm = /(\d+)\s*cm/i.exec(raw) || /(\d+)\s*cm/i.exec(String((p && p.name) || '')); var cm = mm ? mm[1] : '';
  var t = raw.replace(/\d+\s*cm/ig, '').replace(/^\s*bánh\s+/i, '').replace(/sầu\s+riêng/ig, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!t) t = String((p && p.name) || '').replace(/\d+\s*cm/ig, '').trim();
  t = t.toLocaleUpperCase('vi');
  return { name: t, cm: cm, cls: t.length <= 11 ? 's1' : (t.length <= 18 ? 's2' : 's3') };
}
function pdpBuild(box, p) {
  if (!box || !p || box.querySelector('.pdp-brand')) return;
  var tx = pdpTexts(p); box.classList.add('pdp');
  box.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', '<img class="pdp-logo" src="' + PDP_LOGO + '" alt=""><img class="pdp-brand" src="' + PDP_WM + '" alt="">'
    + '<div class="pdp-name"><span class="l1">BÁNH SẦU RIÊNG</span><span class="l2 ' + tx.cls + '"></span></div>' + (tx.cm ? '<div class="pdp-size"></div>' : ''));
  box.querySelector('.l2').textContent = tx.name;
  var sz = box.querySelector('.pdp-size'); if (sz) sz.textContent = 'SIZE ' + tx.cm + 'CM';
}
function pdPosterize() {
  var grid = document.getElementById('productGrid'); if (!grid) return;
  var list = pdListNow(), wraps = grid.querySelectorAll('.product-img-wrap');
  for (var i = 0; i < wraps.length && i < list.length; i++) if (wraps[i].querySelector('canvas.pd-3d')) pdpBuild(wraps[i], list[i]);
}
var _pdDecP = pdDecorate;
pdDecorate = function () { _pdDecP.apply(this, arguments); try { pdPosterize(); } catch (e) {} };
var _pdClearP = pdClear;
pdClear = function () {
  _pdClearP.apply(this, arguments);
  document.querySelectorAll('.product-img-wrap.pdp').forEach(function (w) {
    w.classList.remove('pdp'); Array.prototype.forEach.call(w.querySelectorAll('.pdp-logo,.pdp-brand,.pdp-name,.pdp-size'), function (e) { e.remove(); });
  });
};

/* ---- nối vào initGrid: áp ghim lần đầu + cỡ ô + nút phóng to ---- */
var _initGridPin = initGrid;
initGrid = function () {
  try { pinApplyOnce(); } catch (e) {}
  try { pgApplySize(); } catch (e) {}
  _initGridPin.apply(this, arguments);
  try { pdAddZoomBtns(); } catch (e) {}
  try { pdPosterize(); } catch (e) {}
  try { pinRender(); } catch (e) {}
};
try { pinRender(); pgApplySize(); } catch (e) {}
</script>

<style id="modern-theme">
/* ===== KHUNG THEME — xanh rêu đậm + vàng gold, Playfair + Be Vietnam Pro (chỉ ghi đè giao diện, không đụng logic) ===== */
:root{
  --g9:#0A261D;--g8:#103A2D;--g6:#1C634C;--g4:#3C9272;--gold2:#E9D8A6;
  --serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Be Vietnam Pro','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
  --ink:#14241D;--forest:#103A2D;--forest-2:#0A261D;--sage:#3C9272;--sage-soft:#E7F0EA;
  --cream:#EEF2EE;--cream-2:#E4EBE6;--gold:#C9A24B;--gold-soft:#FBF3DC;--gold-deep:#8F6B1E;
  --red:#B3261E;--gray:#6A7B73;--line:#DCE4DE;--radius:22px;--radius-sm:16px;
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(10,38,29,.04),0 10px 24px -18px rgba(10,38,29,.28);
  --shadow-md:0 18px 36px -20px rgba(10,38,29,.38);--shadow-lg:0 30px 60px -24px rgba(10,38,29,.5);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  --grad-brand:linear-gradient(135deg,#0A261D,#103A2D 55%,#1C634C);
  --grad-warm:linear-gradient(145deg,#C9A24B,#B48A35);
}
body{background:radial-gradient(700px 360px at 100% 0%,rgba(201,162,75,.10),transparent 60%),var(--cream)!important;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
::selection{background:var(--gold2);color:var(--g9)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.hd-title,.page-hd h4,.kpi-val,.stat-val,.cmodal-hd,.login-box h3{font-family:var(--serif)!important;font-weight:600!important;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums;font-feature-settings:"lnum" 1}

/* ---------- Thanh trên ---------- */
.hd{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--g9),var(--g8))!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(233,216,166,.25)!important;box-shadow:0 10px 28px -16px rgba(10,38,29,.6)!important}
.hd::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);background-size:200% 100%;animation:kFlow 7s linear infinite}
@keyframes kFlow{to{background-position:200% 0}}
.hd-title{font-size:17px!important;letter-spacing:.5px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff 40%,var(--gold2) 60%,#fff 80%);background-size:220% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:kShine 6s ease-in-out infinite}
.hd-title img{-webkit-text-fill-color:initial}
@keyframes kShine{0%,20%{background-position:100% 0}80%,100%{background-position:0 0}}
.hd-user{color:var(--gold2)}
.hd-actions .btn[style*="0891b2"]{background:rgba(233,216,166,.14)!important;color:var(--gold2)!important;border:1px solid rgba(233,216,166,.4)!important}
.hd-actions .btn[style*="gold-deep"],#mobileViewBtn{background:var(--grad-warm)!important;color:var(--g9)!important}

/* ---------- Menu trái (tối, vạch vàng) ---------- */
.side-nav{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--g9),var(--g8))!important;border-right:0!important;box-shadow:8px 0 30px -18px rgba(10,38,29,.6)!important;backdrop-filter:none!important}
.side-nav .side-nav-toggle{color:#CFE0D7;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:12px}
.side-nav .side-nav-toggle:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-color:var(--gold);color:#fff;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
.side-nav .tnl{position:relative;color:#CFE0D7!important;border-radius:12px!important;border-left:0!important;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;transition:background .2s,color .2s,transform .25s var(--ease)!important}
.side-nav .tnl i{color:#8FB0A2!important;transition:transform .35s var(--ease),color .2s}
.side-nav .tnl:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)!important;color:#fff!important;transform:translateX(3px)!important}
.side-nav .tnl:hover i{transform:scale(1.15) rotate(-4deg)}
.side-nav .tnl.active{background:rgba(201,162,75,.16)!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:600;box-shadow:none!important}
.side-nav .tnl.active i{color:var(--gold2)!important}
.side-nav .tnl.active::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-8px;top:9px;bottom:9px;width:3px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:var(--gold)}
html:not([data-vp="phone"]) body::after{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)!important;border:1px solid rgba(233,216,166,.25)!important;color:var(--gold2)!important;box-shadow:none!important}

/* ---------- Tiêu đề trang con ---------- */
.page-hd{background:radial-gradient(420px 200px at 100% 0%,rgba(201,162,75,.30),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(360px 200px at 0% 120%,rgba(60,146,114,.45),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g9),var(--g8))!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(233,216,166,.25);box-shadow:0 12px 24px -16px rgba(10,38,29,.55)}
.page-hd h4{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.2px}
.btn-back{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)!important;border:1px solid rgba(233,216,166,.3)!important}
.btn-xls{background:var(--grad-warm)!important;color:var(--g9)!important}

/* ---------- Nút ---------- */
.btn,.tnl,.btn-bill-toggle,.btn-back,.btn-xls,.btn-pay{position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s,filter .25s,background .25s,color .25s!important}
.btn:hover,.btn-back:hover,.btn-xls:hover,.btn-pay:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 22px -12px rgba(10,38,29,.55);filter:brightness(1.07)}
.btn:active,.tnl:active,.btn-bill-toggle:active,.btn-back:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.97)!important}
.btn::after,.btn-bill-toggle::after,.btn-back::after,.btn-xls::after,.btn-pay::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-70%;width:45%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(233,216,166,.4),transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);pointer-events:none}
.btn:hover::after,.btn-bill-toggle:hover::after,.btn-back:hover::after,.btn-xls:hover::after,.btn-pay:hover::after{left:130%;transition:left .7s var(--ease)}
.btn-success,.btn-pay{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--g6),var(--g8))!important;border-color:transparent!important;color:#fff!important}
#btnSubmit{background:var(--grad-warm)!important;color:var(--g9)!important;border:0!important;border-radius:16px!important;padding:13px 0!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.6px;box-shadow:0 14px 26px -12px rgba(143,107,30,.7)}
#btnSubmit:not(:disabled){animation:kPulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}
#btnSubmit:not(:disabled):hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
#btnSubmit:disabled{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9FB3AA,#B8C7BF)!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:none;opacity:.9}
@keyframes kPulse{50%{box-shadow:0 14px 34px -8px rgba(201,162,75,.75)}}

/* ---------- Thẻ: bo lớn, vạch vàng chạy khi rê, ánh sáng theo chuột ---------- */
.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.filter-bar,.tbl-wrap,.price-box{border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:22px!important;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)!important}
.stat-card{border-left-width:4px!important;border-radius:18px!important}
.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.product-card{position:relative;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s!important;animation:kRv .7s var(--ease) backwards}
.kpi-card:hover,.stat-card:hover,.chart-card:hover,.product-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)!important;border-color:var(--gold2)!important;box-shadow:0 22px 40px -22px rgba(10,38,29,.4)!important}
.kpi-card::before,.stat-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:3px;width:0;right:auto;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold2));transition:width .35s;z-index:2}
.kpi-card:hover::before,.stat-card:hover::after{width:100%}
.stat-card{overflow:hidden}
.kpi-card::after,.chart-card::after,.product-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;background:radial-gradient(260px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),rgba(201,162,75,.20),transparent 65%);z-index:3}
.kpi-card:hover::after,.chart-card:hover::after,.product-card:hover::after{opacity:1}
.kpi-lbl,.stat-lbl{color:var(--gray);letter-spacing:.3px}
.kpi-val,.stat-val{color:var(--g8);font-size:26px}
.chart-card h6{color:var(--g8);font-family:var(--sans)}
@keyframes kRv{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}}
:is(.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.product-card):nth-child(2){animation-delay:70ms}
:is(.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.product-card):nth-child(3){animation-delay:140ms}
:is(.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.product-card):nth-child(4){animation-delay:210ms}
:is(.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.product-card):nth-child(5){animation-delay:280ms}
:is(.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.product-card):nth-child(6){animation-delay:350ms}
:is(.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.product-card):nth-child(n+7){animation-delay:420ms}

/* ---------- Sản phẩm ---------- */
.product-card{border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:18px!important;background:#fff!important}
.product-img-wrap{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#fff,var(--sage-soft))!important}
.product-img{transition:transform .5s var(--ease)!important}
.product-card:hover .product-img{transform:scale(1.08) rotate(-1.5deg)!important}
.product-name{color:var(--g9)!important;font-weight:600}
.product-price{display:inline-block;margin-top:4px;padding:2px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12.5px!important;color:var(--g9)!important;background:var(--grad-warm);font-weight:700;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
.product-card:hover .product-price{transform:scale(1.08)}
.product-cat-tag{background:rgba(10,38,29,.78)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);color:var(--gold2)!important}
.q-badge{background:var(--grad-warm)!important;color:var(--g9)!important}
.cat-btn{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;color:var(--g8)!important;padding:8px 18px!important;font-weight:500!important;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),border-color .25s,background .25s,color .25s!important}
.cat-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)!important;border-color:var(--gold)!important}
.cat-btn.active{background:var(--g8)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:var(--g8)!important;box-shadow:0 10px 20px -12px rgba(10,38,29,.6)!important}
.btn-edit-sp:hover{background:var(--gold)!important;color:var(--g9)!important;transform:scale(1.15) rotate(10deg)}

/* ---------- Giỏ hàng, hóa đơn ---------- */
.cart-wrap{border-radius:26px!important;border-top:0!important;background:#fff!important;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)!important}
.cart-wrap::before{content:"";position:sticky;top:-16px;display:block;height:4px;margin:-16px -16px 14px;border-radius:26px 26px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--g8),var(--gold),var(--gold2));z-index:7}
.cart-footer{background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.btn-bill-toggle{background:var(--gold-soft)!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important;border:1px solid var(--gold)!important;border-radius:12px!important}
.btn-bill-toggle:hover,.btn-bill-toggle.active{background:var(--grad-warm)!important;color:var(--g9)!important}
.section-title{border-left:0!important;padding-left:0!important;color:var(--g8)!important;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.section-title::before{content:"";width:4px;height:15px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(var(--gold),var(--gold2));flex-shrink:0}
.cust-header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sage-soft),#fff)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:14px!important}
.price-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,var(--gold-soft))!important;border:1.5px solid rgba(201,162,75,.55)!important}
#invoicePanel .inv-hd{background:radial-gradient(300px 160px at 100% 0%,rgba(201,162,75,.30),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g9),var(--g8))!important;color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif)}

/* ---------- Ô nhập ---------- */
.form-control,.form-select,input[type=text],input[type=number],input[type=tel],input[type=date],input[type=password],textarea,select{border-radius:12px!important;border-color:var(--line)!important;background-color:#F6F9F7;transition:box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s,background .25s!important}
.form-control:focus,.form-select:focus,input:focus,textarea:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--gold)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(201,162,75,.2)!important;background-color:#fff;outline:0!important}
#priceKey{border-color:var(--gold)!important;background:#fff!important}

/* ---------- Bảng ---------- */
.tbl-wrap thead th,.mc-table th{background:var(--g8)!important;color:var(--gold2)!important;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px}
.tbl-wrap tbody tr:hover,.dtbl tbody tr:hover,.mc-table tbody tr:hover{background:var(--sage-soft)!important}
.mc-rev{color:var(--g8)}

/* ---------- Popup ---------- */
.cmodal-overlay{background:rgba(8,28,21,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
.cmodal{border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.cmodal-hd{border-radius:26px 26px 0 0;font-size:17px;padding:17px 20px}
.cmodal-hd.green,.cmodal-hd.blue,.cmodal-hd.dark{background:radial-gradient(300px 160px at 100% 0%,rgba(201,162,75,.32),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g9),var(--g8))}
.cmodal-hd.amber,.cmodal-hd.warn{background:var(--grad-warm);color:var(--g9)}
.cmodal-hd.danger{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#C0395E,#8C2441)}
.cmodal-close{border-radius:50%}

/* ---------- Đăng nhập ---------- */
#loginScreen{background:radial-gradient(520px 300px at 90% 0%,rgba(201,162,75,.30),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(420px 300px at 0% 110%,rgba(60,146,114,.5),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g9),var(--g8));overflow:hidden}
#loginScreen::before,#loginScreen::after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(64px);pointer-events:none;animation:kDrift 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#loginScreen::before{width:340px;height:340px;background:var(--gold);right:6%;top:-130px;opacity:.3}
#loginScreen::after{width:380px;height:380px;background:#2E8B6A;left:30%;bottom:-210px;opacity:.45;animation-delay:-6s}
@keyframes kDrift{to{transform:translate(-70px,46px) scale(1.18)}}
.login-box{position:relative;z-index:1;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-top:4px solid var(--gold)}
.login-box h3{color:var(--g8)!important}

/* ---------- Dock điện thoại, thông báo, thanh cuộn ---------- */
.bn-item.active,.bn-item:active{color:var(--g6)}
.bn-fab{background:var(--grad-brand)!important}.bn-fab i{color:var(--gold2)}
.toast-msg{background:var(--g9)!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid rgba(233,216,166,.3);border-radius:999px!important}
*{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--g4) transparent}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:linear-gradient(var(--g4),var(--g6));border-radius:8px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.kpi-card,.stat-card,.chart-card,.product-card,#btnSubmit,.hd::after,.hd-title,#loginScreen::before,#loginScreen::after{animation:none!important}.btn,.tnl,.cat-btn,.product-card,.product-img{transition:none!important}}
</style>
<script id="khung-fx">
(function(){if(matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches)return;
var sel='.kpi-card,.chart-card,.product-card',raf=0;
document.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){if(e.pointerType==='touch'||raf)return;
var c=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(sel);if(!c)return;
raf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){raf=0;var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--mx',(e.clientX-r.left)+'px');c.style.setProperty('--my',(e.clientY-r.top)+'px')})},{passive:true});
})();
</script>
</script>
<style id="resp-cart-css">
/* ===== Số cột sản phẩm: PC 4 · iPad/Tab 3 · Điện thoại 2 ===== */
html[data-vp="desktop"] #productGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)) !important;}
html[data-vp="tablet"] #productGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) !important;}
html[data-vp="phone"] #productGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)) !important;gap:8px !important;}
#pgSizeBtn{display:none !important;}

/* ===== Giỏ hàng nổi (điện thoại, iPad, tab) ===== */
html:not([data-vp="desktop"]) .order-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;}
#cartOv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1400;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;background:rgba(8,28,21,.55);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);}
#cartOv.on{display:flex;}
#cartOv .cart-wrap{position:relative !important;top:auto !important;width:min(560px,100%);max-height:92vh !important;max-height:92dvh !important;overflow-y:auto !important;overflow-x:hidden !important;margin:0 !important;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.6) !important;animation:cartIn .28s var(--ease);}
#cartOv .cart-footer{position:sticky !important;bottom:0 !important;margin:0 -16px !important;padding:10px 16px 14px !important;}
@keyframes cartIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.97);}}
#cartClose{width:34px;height:34px;margin-left:8px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--g8);font-size:20px;line-height:1;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;cursor:pointer;}
#cartClose:hover{border-color:var(--gold);}
#cartOv #cartClose{display:inline-flex;}
.cart-hd-row{gap:8px;}
#cartFab{position:fixed;z-index:1300;width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--grad-warm);color:var(--g9);font-size:24px;box-shadow:0 14px 28px -10px rgba(180,138,53,.95);touch-action:none;cursor:grab;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;transition:transform .2s;}
#cartFab.show{display:flex;}
#cartFab:active{cursor:grabbing;transform:scale(.95);}
#cartFab.bump{animation:fabBump .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);}
@keyframes fabBump{0%{transform:scale(1);}40%{transform:scale(1.18);}100%{transform:scale(1);}}
#cartFab .n{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;min-width:24px;height:24px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;background:#E5253D;color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff;font:800 12.5px/20px var(--sans,'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif);text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(229,37,61,.5);}
#cartFab .n[hidden]{display:none;}
</style>
<script id="resp-cart-js">
(function(){
  var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);};
  var wrap=document.querySelector('.cart-wrap'); if(!wrap) return;
  var home=wrap.parentNode, de=document.documentElement;
  var ov=document.createElement('div'); ov.id='cartOv'; document.body.appendChild(ov);
  var fab=document.createElement('button'); fab.type='button'; fab.id='cartFab'; fab.setAttribute('aria-label','Mở giỏ hàng');
  fab.innerHTML='<i class="fa fa-shopping-basket"></i><b class="n" id="cartFabN" hidden>0</b>';
  document.body.appendChild(fab);
  var cb=document.createElement('button'); cb.type='button'; cb.id='cartClose'; cb.setAttribute('aria-label','Đóng giỏ hàng'); cb.innerHTML='&times;';
  var hr=wrap.querySelector('.cart-hd-row'); if(hr) hr.appendChild(cb);

  function isPop(){ return de.getAttribute('data-vp')!=='desktop'; }
  function openCart(){ ov.classList.add('on'); de.classList.add('cart-open'); vis(); }
  function closeCart(){ ov.classList.remove('on'); de.classList.remove('cart-open'); vis(); }
  function place(){
    var pop=isPop();
    if(pop && wrap.parentNode!==ov){ ov.appendChild(wrap); home.style.display='none'; }
    else if(!pop && wrap.parentNode===ov){ ov.classList.remove('on'); de.classList.remove('cart-open'); home.appendChild(wrap); home.style.display=''; }
    vis(); clamp();
  }
  function vis(){
    var po=$('page-order'), ls=$('loginScreen');
    var logged=!ls || getComputedStyle(ls).display==='none';
    var on=isPop() && po && po.classList.contains('active') && logged && !ov.classList.contains('on');
    fab.classList.toggle('show',!!on);
  }
  function badge(){
    var n=0; try{ for(var k in cart){ n+=(+cart[k]>0?+cart[k]:0); } }catch(e){}
    var b=$('cartFabN'); if(!b) return;
    var old=b.hidden?0:(+b.textContent||0);
    b.textContent=n>99?'99+':n; b.hidden=n<=0;
    if(n>old){ fab.classList.remove('bump'); void fab.offsetWidth; fab.classList.add('bump'); }
  }
  var _uc=window.updateCart;
  if(typeof _uc==='function'){ window.updateCart=function(){ var r=_uc.apply(this,arguments); try{badge();}catch(e){} return r; }; }

  /* kéo thả, nhớ vị trí */
  var KEY='cart_fab_pos', pos=null, SZ=62;
  function cv(n){ return parseFloat(getComputedStyle(de).getPropertyValue(n))||0; } function VT(){ return cv('--vis-t'); } function VB(){ return cv('--vis-b'); }
  try{ pos=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null'); }catch(e){}
  function setPos(x,y){
    var m=6, vt=VT(), vb=VB(); x=Math.min(innerWidth-SZ-m,Math.max(m,x)); y=Math.min(innerHeight-vb-SZ-m,Math.max(vt+m,y));
    fab.style.left=x+'px'; fab.style.top=y+'px'; fab.style.right='auto'; fab.style.bottom='auto'; return [x,y];
  }
  function clamp(){ if(pos) setPos(pos[0],pos[1]); else setPos(innerWidth-SZ-14,innerHeight-VB()-SZ-100); }
  var sx=0,sy=0,ox=0,oy=0,drag=false,moved=false;
  fab.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){ drag=true; moved=false; sx=e.clientX; sy=e.clientY; var r=fab.getBoundingClientRect(); ox=r.left; oy=r.top; try{fab.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(x){} });
  fab.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
    if(!drag) return; var dx=e.clientX-sx, dy=e.clientY-sy;
    if(!moved && Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)<8) return;
    moved=true; pos=setPos(ox+dx,oy+dy);
  });
  fab.addEventListener('pointerup',function(){ if(!drag) return; drag=false; if(moved){ try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(pos));}catch(e){} } });
  fab.addEventListener('pointercancel',function(){ drag=false; });
  fab.addEventListener('click',function(){ if(moved){ moved=false; return; } openCart(); });

  cb.addEventListener('click',closeCart);
  ov.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){ if(e.target===ov) closeCart(); });
  ov.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(e.target===ov) closeCart(); });
  addEventListener('vis-fit',function(){ clamp(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape' && ov.classList.contains('on')) closeCart(); });
  addEventListener('resize',function(){ setTimeout(place,120); });
  addEventListener('orientationchange',function(){ setTimeout(place,300); });
  setInterval(function(){ place(); },600);
  place(); badge();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
<style id="po-css">
.btn-paste-order{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;width:100%;margin:0 0 10px;padding:9px 12px;border:1.5px dashed var(--forest);border-radius:10px;background:var(--sage-soft);color:var(--forest);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.btn-paste-order:hover{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border-style:solid}
.po-ov{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2000000;background:rgba(14,30,22,.55);align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px;font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif}
.po-ov.on{display:flex}
.po-box{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;width:min(760px,100%);max-height:94vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4);overflow:hidden;border-top:5px solid var(--forest)}
.po-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px;color:var(--forest);font-size:15px}
.po-x{border:0;background:#eee;border-radius:8px;width:30px;height:30px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.po-body{padding:0 16px 12px;overflow:auto;flex:1;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink)}
.po-ft{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--cream)}
.po-help{background:var(--gold-soft);border:1px solid #efd6a3;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12.5px}
.po-ta{width:100%;border:1.5px solid #cfd8d2;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5;resize:vertical}
.po-btn{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 18px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;background:#e5e7eb;color:#374151}
.po-btn.pri{background:var(--forest);color:#fff}
.po-btn.sm{padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px}
.po-btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.po-mini{border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;background:#eee;cursor:pointer}
.po-mini.del{color:var(--red)}
.po-sec{font-weight:800;color:var(--forest);margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.po-sum{font-weight:600;text-transform:none;color:var(--gray);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0}
.po-red{color:var(--red)}
.po-alert{background:#fde8e6;border:1px solid #f3b6b0;color:var(--red);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin:8px 0;font-weight:700}
.po-kv{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line)}
.po-kv span{flex:0 0 110px;color:var(--gray)}
.po-kv b{font-weight:600;word-break:break-word}
.po-cs{margin-top:6px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:8px;background:#f3f4f6}
.po-cs.ok{background:var(--sage-soft);color:var(--forest);font-weight:600}
.po-cs.warn{background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--gold-deep)}
.po-row{border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-left-width:6px;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:7px}
.po-row.ok{border-left-color:#2f8f57;background:#f6fbf7}
.po-row.warn{border-left-color:var(--amber);background:#fffaf0}
.po-row.bad{border-left-color:var(--red);background:#fff5f4}
.po-row.rm{opacity:.55;border-left-color:#bbb}
.po-line1{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px}
.po-raw{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12.5px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:2px 7px;word-break:break-word}
.po-badge{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;border-radius:6px;padding:2px 7px;color:#fff}
.po-badge.ok{background:#2f8f57}.po-badge.warn{background:var(--amber)}.po-badge.bad{background:var(--red)}
.po-line2{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.po-sel{flex:1 1 220px;min-width:0;border:1px solid #cfd8d2;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12.5px}
.po-qty{width:70px;border:1px solid #cfd8d2;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-align:center}
.po-why{font-size:12px;color:var(--red);margin-top:5px}
.po-why.info{color:var(--gray)}
.po-tick{font-size:11.5px;color:#2f8f57;font-weight:700}
.po-rem{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;color:var(--gray)}
.po-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px}
.po-chip{background:var(--sage-soft);border:1px solid var(--sage);border-radius:20px;padding:3px 11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--forest);font-size:12px}
.po-nl{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:flex-start;padding:4px 0;font-size:12.5px}
.po-nl.unk{color:var(--gray)}
.po-skip,.po-alias{margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--gray)}
.po-arow{padding:2px 0;word-break:break-word}
.po-mode{flex:1 1 100%;font-size:12.5px}
@media(max-width:560px){.po-ov{padding:0;align-items:flex-end}.po-box{max-height:97vh;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;width:100%}}
.po-seg{margin:10px 0;padding:8px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px}.po-seg.first{border-color:var(--forest)}.po-segh{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12.5px}
</style>
<script id="po-parser">
/* PasteOrder parser - 9 Sạch System. Thuần JS, không phụ thuộc DOM. */
(function (root, factory) {
  if (typeof module === 'object' && module.exports) module.exports = factory();
  else root.PasteOrderParser = factory();
})(typeof self !== 'undefined' ? self : this, function () {
  'use strict';

  function norm(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/đ/g, 'd').replace(/Đ/g, 'd')
      .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase();
  }
  function fold(s) { return norm(s).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); }

  /* ---------- 1. Lập chỉ mục danh mục: mỗi SP -> {fam,size,setN} ---------- */
  function indexCatalog(products) {
    var out = [];
    (products || []).forEach(function (p) {
      var n = fold((p.name || '') + ' ' + (p.detailName || ''));
      var fam = null, size = null, setN = null, m;
      if ((m = n.match(/\bset (\d+)/))) { fam = 'set'; setN = +m[1]; }
      else if (/\bthan\b/.test(n)) fam = 'than';
      else if (/\bchoco|chocolate|socola/.test(n)) fam = 'choco';
      else if (/khoai mon|\btim\b/.test(n)) fam = 'tim';
      else if (/\bpsx\b|phu si la dua/.test(n)) fam = 'psx';
      else if (/\bmix\b|3 vi/.test(n)) fam = 'mix';
      else if (/\bxanh\b/.test(n)) fam = 'xanh';
      else if (/\bvang\b|ngan lop truyen thong/.test(n)) fam = 'vang';
      if (fam && fam !== 'set') {
        var ms = n.match(/(\d+) ?cm/) || String(p.name || '').match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
        if (ms) size = +ms[1];
      }
      out.push({ id: String(p.id), name: p.name, fam: fam, size: size, setN: setN });
    });
    return out;
  }
  function famSizes(idx, fam) {
    var s = {};
    idx.forEach(function (p) { if (p.fam === fam && p.size) s[p.size] = 1; });
    return Object.keys(s).map(Number).sort();
  }
  function findIds(idx, fam, size, setN) {
    return idx.filter(function (p) {
      if (p.fam !== fam) return false;
      if (fam === 'set') return p.setN === setN;
      return p.size === size;
    }).map(function (p) { return p.id; });
  }
  function idsOfFam(idx, fams) {
    return idx.filter(function (p) { return fams.indexOf(p.fam) >= 0; }).map(function (p) { return p.id; });
  }

  /* ---------- 2. Từ điển viết tắt (theo thứ tự ưu tiên) ---------- */
  var RULES = [
    { fam: 'tim',   re: /\b(?:ps |phu si )?(?:khoai mon|mon|tim)\b/g },
    { fam: 'than',  re: /\b(?:ps |phu si )?(?:pho ?mai )?than(?: tre| hoat tinh)?\b/g },
    { fam: 'choco', re: /\b(?:ps |phu si )?(?:choco|chocolate|socola|so co la)\b/g },
    { fam: 'psx',   re: /\b(?:psx|ps dua|ps la dua|ps xanh|phu si la dua|phu si dua|phu si xanh)\b/g },
    { fam: 'mix',   re: /\b(?:mix|mv)\b/g },
    { fam: 'xanh',  re: /\b(?:xtt|tt xanh|truyen thong xanh|ngan lop xanh|xanh)\b/g },
    { fam: 'vang',  re: /\b(?:vtt|tt vang|truyen thong vang|ngan lop vang|vang|v)\b/g },
    { fam: 'psx',   re: /\bps\b/g },   // chốt 29/10: "ps" trơn = PSX (ps tím đã bắt ở luật 'tim' phía trên)
    { fam: 'xanh', re: /\b(?:la dua|dua)\b/g },   // chốt 29/10: "lá dứa" trơn = Xanh (ngàn lớp xanh)
    { amb: ['tim', 'psx', 'choco', 'than'], re: /\bphu si\b/g, why: '"phú sĩ" chưa nói rõ vị' },
    { amb: ['vang', 'xanh'], re: /\b(?:tt|truyen thong|ngan lop)\b/g, why: '"truyền thống" có cả Vàng và Xanh' },
    { fam: 'xanh', weak: true, re: /\bx\b/g, why: '"x" có thể là Xanh hoặc dấu nhân' }
  ];
  var STOP = { banh: 1, cai: 1, chiec: 1, o: 1, hop: 1, size: 1, cm: 1, loai: 1, vi: 1, c: 1 };

  /* ---------- 3. Phân tích 1 dòng hàng ---------- */
  function parseProductLine(raw, ctx, idx, learned) {
    var r = { raw: raw, fam: null, size: null, setN: null, qty: null, ids: [], cands: [], reasons: [], note: '', famHit: false, hasNum: false, header: false, sizeFrom: '' };
    var body = raw, pi = raw.indexOf('(');
    if (pi >= 0) { r.note = raw.slice(pi + 1).replace(/[)\s]+$/, '').trim(); body = raw.slice(0, pi); }
    var t = fold(body);

    // size tường minh: "size 12cm", "12cm", "size 16"
    var explicit = null, m;
    t = t.replace(/\b(?:size )?(\d{1,2}) ?cm\b/, function (_, d) { explicit = +d; return ' '; });
    if (explicit == null) t = t.replace(/\bsize (\d{1,2})\b/, function (_, d) { explicit = +d; return ' '; });
    t = t.replace(/\bcrepe? mini ?(\d) ?(?:chiec|cai|c)\b/g, ' set $1 ');   // "6 hộp crep mini 4 chiếc" = 6 × Set 4
    t = t.replace(/\b(?:3|ba) vi\b/g, ' mix ');                 // "mix 3 vị": số 3 KHÔNG phải số lượng
    t = t.replace(/([a-z])(\d)/g, '$1 $2').replace(/(\d)([a-z])/g, '$1 $2');   // v16 -> v 16, 6c -> 6 c
    var tok = t.split(' ').filter(Boolean);

    // gom token: số (kèm cờ 'c'), từ
    var items = [];
    tok.forEach(function (w) {
      if (/^\d+$/.test(w)) items.push({ n: true, v: +w, c: false, len: w.length });
      else if ((w === 'c' || w === 'cai') && items.length && items[items.length - 1].n && !items[items.length - 1].c) items[items.length - 1].c = true;
      else items.push({ n: false, w: w });
    });
    items.forEach(function (it, i) { it.i = i; });

    // set
    var setIdx = -1;
    items.forEach(function (it) { if (!it.n && it.w === 'set' && setIdx < 0) setIdx = it.i; });
    var removed = {};
    if (setIdx >= 0) {
      var nx = items[setIdx + 1];
      if (nx && nx.n) { r.setN = nx.v; removed[nx.i] = 1; }
      removed[setIdx] = 1; r.fam = 'set'; r.famHit = true;
    }

    var words = items.filter(function (it) { return !it.n && !removed[it.i] && !STOP[it.w]; }).map(function (it) { return it.w; });
    var ws = words.join(' ');
    var firstWord = items.reduce(function (a, it) { return (!it.n && !STOP[it.w] && a < 0) ? it.i : a; }, -1);
    var amb = null, weak = null, fams = [];

    if (r.fam !== 'set') {
      var lk = learned && learned[ws];
      if (lk) { fams.push(lk); ws = ''; r.famHit = true; r.learned = true; }
      else {
        RULES.forEach(function (rule) {
          var hit = false;
          ws = ws.replace(rule.re, function () { hit = true; return ' '; });
          if (!hit) return;
          r.famHit = true;
          if (rule.fam && !rule.weak) { if (fams.indexOf(rule.fam) < 0) fams.push(rule.fam); }
          else if (rule.weak) { weak = rule; }
          else { amb = rule; }
        });
      }
      ws = ws.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
    var leftover = ws ? ws.split(' ').filter(function (w) { return !STOP[w]; }) : [];

    // số còn lại (sau khi bỏ số của set)
    var nums = items.filter(function (it) { return it.n && !removed[it.i]; });
    nums.forEach(function (x) { x.before = (firstWord < 0 || (setIdx >= 0 && setIdx < firstWord ? setIdx : firstWord) > x.i); });
    if (setIdx >= 0) nums.forEach(function (x) { x.before = x.i < setIdx; });
    r.hasNum = nums.some(function (x) { return x.len <= 3; });

    // header kiểu "Bánh 12cm"
    if (!r.famHit && !nums.length && explicit != null && !leftover.length) { r.header = true; r.size = explicit; return r; }

    // chọn họ
    if (r.fam !== 'set') {
      if (fams.length === 1 && !amb && !weak) r.fam = fams[0];
      else if (fams.length === 0 && amb && !weak) { r.cands = idsOfFam(idx, amb.amb); r.reasons.push(amb.why); r.fam = null; }
      else if (fams.length === 0 && weak && !amb) { r.fam = weak.fam; r.weakFam = true; r.reasons.push(weak.why); }
      else if (fams.length > 1) { r.cands = idsOfFam(idx, fams); r.reasons.push('Dòng có nhiều loại bánh: ' + fams.join(' + ')); }
      else if (fams.length === 1 && (amb || weak)) { r.fam = fams[0]; r.reasons.push('Dòng còn từ mơ hồ: ' + (amb || weak).why); }
    }
    if (leftover.length) r.reasons.push('Từ chưa nhận ra: "' + leftover.join(' ') + '"');

    // số lượng / size
    var nn = nums.filter(function (x) { return x.len <= 3; });
    var big = nums.filter(function (x) { return x.len > 3; });
    if (big.length) r.reasons.push('Có số lớn chưa dùng: ' + big.map(function (x) { return x.v; }).join(', '));
    var size = explicit, qty = null;
    var validSizes = r.fam && r.fam !== 'set' ? famSizes(idx, r.fam) : [12, 16];
    var isSz = function (v) { return validSizes.indexOf(v) >= 0 || v === 12 || v === 16; };

    if (r.fam === 'set') {
      if (explicit != null) r.reasons.push('Set không có size, bỏ "' + explicit + 'cm"');
      if (nn.length === 1) { qty = nn[0].v; if (!nn[0].c && !nn[0].before && [2, 4, 6].indexOf(qty) >= 0) r.reasons.push('Số ' + qty + ' sau chữ "set" không có chữ c/cái — SL hay loại set? Kiểm tra lại'); }
      else if (nn.length === 0) { /* thiếu SL */ }
      else if (nn.length === 2) {
        var cs = nn.filter(function (x) { return x.c; });
        if (cs.length === 1) qty = cs[0].v;
        else { qty = nn[1].v; r.reasons.push('Hai số sau chữ "set": lấy số đầu = loại set, số sau = SL — kiểm tra lại'); }
      } else r.reasons.push('Quá nhiều số trong dòng');
      size = null;
    } else {
      if (nn.length === 1) {
        var x = nn[0];
        if (x.c || x.before || explicit != null || !isSz(x.v)) qty = x.v;
        else { size = x.v; r.sizeOnly = true; r.reasons.push('Chỉ thấy size ' + x.v + 'cm (số sau tên bánh = size) — nhập số lượng'); }   // chốt 29/10: "mix 12" = Mix size 12
      } else if (nn.length === 2) {
        var a = nn[0], b = nn[1];
        if (explicit != null) { r.reasons.push('Thừa số trong dòng (đã có size ' + explicit + 'cm)'); qty = a.before ? a.v : null; }
        else if (a.before && !b.before && isSz(b.v)) { qty = a.v; size = b.v; }
        else if (!a.before && !b.before) {
          var ca = nn.filter(function (x) { return x.c; });
          if (ca.length === 1) { var o = ca[0] === a ? b : a; qty = ca[0].v; if (isSz(o.v)) size = o.v; else r.reasons.push('Số ' + o.v + ' không phải size 12/16'); }
          else if (isSz(a.v) && !isSz(b.v)) { size = a.v; qty = b.v; }
          else if (!isSz(a.v) && isSz(b.v)) { qty = a.v; size = b.v; }
          else r.reasons.push('Hai số ' + a.v + ' và ' + b.v + ' — không rõ cái nào là SL, cái nào là size');
        } else r.reasons.push('Hai số ' + a.v + ' và ' + b.v + ' — không rõ SL / size');
      } else if (nn.length > 2) r.reasons.push('Quá nhiều số trong dòng');
    }

    if (qty != null && (qty < 1 || qty > 200)) { r.reasons.push('SL ' + qty + ' bất thường'); }
    if (qty == null && !r.ambNum && !r.sizeOnly) r.reasons.push('Không thấy số lượng');
    r.qty = qty;

    // size
    if (r.fam && r.fam !== 'set') {
      if (size == null && ctx && ctx.size) { size = ctx.size; r.sizeFrom = 'header'; }
      if (size == null) {
        r.reasons.push('Thiếu size 12/16');
        r.cands = idsOfFam(idx, [r.fam]);
      }
    }
    r.size = size;

    // tra SP
    if (r.fam && (r.fam === 'set' || size != null)) {
      var ids = findIds(idx, r.fam, size, r.setN);
      if (ids.length === 1) r.ids = ids;
      else if (ids.length > 1) { r.cands = ids; r.reasons.push('Có ' + ids.length + ' SP trùng khớp'); }
      else r.reasons.push('Danh mục không có ' + (r.fam === 'set' ? 'Set ' + r.setN : r.fam.toUpperCase() + ' ' + size));
    }
    // ứng viên gợi ý theo họ
    if (!r.ids.length && !r.cands.length && r.fam) r.cands = idsOfFam(idx, [r.fam]);

    // trạng thái
    if (r.ids.length === 1 && !r.reasons.length && qty != null) r.status = 'ok';
    else if (!r.famHit || (!r.ids.length && !r.cands.length)) r.status = 'bad';
    else r.status = 'warn';
    if (r.ids.length === 1 && r.weakFam) r.status = 'warn';
    r.wordKey = words.join(' ');
    return r;
  }

  /* ---------- 4. Phân tích cả đoạn chat ---------- */
  var ADDR_MARK = /\b(phuong|xa|quan|tp|thanh pho|tinh|duong|kp|khu pho|ap|kv|so nha|khom|ward)\b/;
  var CODE_RE = /\b([a-z]{4,8})-(\d{3,5})\b/;
  var PHONE_RE = /(^|[^\d])(0\d{3}[ .]?\d{3}[ .]?\d{3})(?!\d)/g;
  var EMAIL_RE = /[a-z0-9._%+\-]+@[a-z0-9.\-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/i;
  var EXTRA_ITEMS = [   // hàng ngoài danh mục -> đưa vào ghi chú đơn, không vào giỏ
    { re: /\bpana(?: ?cotta)?\b/, name: 'Panacotta' },
    { re: /\b(?:schua|sua chua)\b/, name: 'Sữa chua' }
  ];
  var NOTE_KEY = /\b(tem|tui muong|cap dong|da bi|ghi thung|dan|gui xe|xe|ngay gui|giao|nhan|ship|kho|xuat|ghi chu|luu y|goi|giu lanh|nhiet)\b/;

  function parseChat(text, products, learned) {
    var idx = indexCatalog(products);
    var lines = String(text || '').split(/\r?\n/);
    var res = {
      rows: [], customer: { code: '', phones: [], cccd: '', mst: '', email: '', invoiceName: '', addresses: [], names: [] },
      chips: {}, noteLines: [], unknown: [], skipped: [], codes: [], stats: {}
    };
    var ctx = { size: null };
    var cust = res.customer;

    lines.forEach(function (orig, li) {
      var L = orig.replace(/^[\s\-–—•*·>❇️🚛❤️📍✳🔹🔸▪️✅⭐️]+/u, '').replace(/[\s\-–—]+$/, '').trim();
      if (!L) return;
      var n = norm(L), f = fold(L), rest = L;

      // mã khách (có thể kèm tên)
      var cm = n.match(CODE_RE);
      if (cm) {
        var code = cm[1].toUpperCase() + '-' + cm[2];
        if (/^DN/.test(code)) code = 'ĐN' + code.slice(2);
        if (res.codes.indexOf(code) < 0) res.codes.push(code);
        if (!cust.code) cust.code = code;
        var stripped = L.replace(/\(?\s*(?:code|ma|mã)?\s*:?\s*[A-Za-zĐđ]{4,8}-\d{3,5}\s*\)?/i, ' ').replace(/\b(code|mã khách|ma khach)\s*:?\s*$/i, '').trim();
        rest = stripped; n = norm(rest); f = fold(rest);
        if (f && f.replace(/\b(code|ma|khach)\b/g, '').trim()) cust.names.push(rest.replace(/[:\s]+$/, ''));
        res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'Mã khách ' + code });
        if (!f || !f.replace(/\b(code|ma|khach)\b/g, '').trim()) return;
        if (/\d/.test(f) && !NOTE_KEY.test(f)) return;   // phần còn lại là tên khách
        return;
      }

      // nhãn có dữ liệu
      var lab;
      if ((lab = n.match(/^(?:mst|ma so thue|mst\/cmnd)\s*[:\-]?\s*([\d\- ]{9,16})/))) { cust.mst = lab[1].replace(/\D/g, ''); res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'MST' }); return; }
      if ((lab = n.match(/^(?:cccd|cmnd|can cuoc[^:]*)\s*[:\-]?\s*([\d ]{9,14})/)) || (lab = n.match(/^ca nhan\s+(?:cccd|cmnd)\s*[:\-]?\s*([\d ]{9,14})/))) { cust.cccd = lab[1].replace(/\D/g, ''); res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'CCCD' }); return; }
      if (EMAIL_RE.test(L)) { cust.email = (L.match(EMAIL_RE) || [''])[0]; res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'Email (không có ô trên đơn)' }); return; }
      if ((lab = L.match(/^(?:xuất hóa đơn|xuat hoa don|xuất hđ|tên công ty|ten cong ty)\s*[:\-]\s*(.+)$/i))) { cust.invoiceName = lab[1].trim(); res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'Tên xuất hóa đơn' }); return; }
      if ((lab = L.match(/^(?:địa chỉ|dia chi|đ\/c|d\/c|dc|đc)(?:\s*mới)?\s*[:\-]\s*(.+)$/i))) { cust.addresses.push(lab[1].trim()); res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'Địa chỉ' }); return; }
      if ((lab = L.match(/^(?:họ và tên|ho va ten|tên khách|ten khach|người nhận|nguoi nhan)\s*[:\-]\s*(.+)$/i))) {
        var nm = lab[1].replace(/[-–]?\s*(?:sđt|sdt|đt)\s*[:\-]?.*$/i, '').trim();
        if (nm) cust.names.push(nm);
        // SĐT cùng dòng
        var ph0, re0 = new RegExp(PHONE_RE.source, 'g');
        while ((ph0 = re0.exec(lab[1]))) { var p0 = ph0[2].replace(/\D/g, ''); if (cust.phones.indexOf(p0) < 0) cust.phones.push(p0); }
        res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'Tên / SĐT khách' }); return;
      }

      // dòng SĐT
      var phs = [], pm, re1 = new RegExp(PHONE_RE.source, 'g'), noPhone = L;
      while ((pm = re1.exec(L))) phs.push(pm[2].replace(/\D/g, ''));
      if (phs.length) {
        noPhone = L.replace(new RegExp(PHONE_RE.source, 'g'), function (_, a) { return a + ' '; });
        phs.forEach(function (p) { if (cust.phones.indexOf(p) < 0) cust.phones.push(p); });
        var leftT = fold(noPhone).replace(/\b(sdt|dt|tel|phone|zalo|lh|so dien thoai)\b/g, '').trim();
        if (!leftT) { res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'SĐT' }); return; }
        L = noPhone.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); n = norm(L); f = fold(L);
        res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'SĐT ' + phs.join(', ') + ' (phần chữ còn lại xử lý tiếp)' });
      }
      // 12 số trần = CCCD
      if (/^\d{12}$/.test(f.replace(/ /g, ''))) { cust.cccd = f.replace(/ /g, ''); res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'CCCD' }); return; }

      // hàng ngoài danh mục (pana = panacotta, schua = sữa chua) -> ghi chú
      var exHit = null;
      EXTRA_ITEMS.forEach(function (e) { if (!exHit && e.re.test(f)) exHit = e; });
      if (exHit) {
        var pi2 = L.indexOf('('), body2 = pi2 >= 0 ? L.slice(0, pi2) : L, qm = fold(body2).match(/\b(\d{1,3})\b/);
        var txt2 = qm ? qm[1] + ' ' + exHit.name + (pi2 >= 0 ? ' ' + L.slice(pi2).trim() : '') : L;
        res.noteLines.push({ text: txt2, on: true });
        return;
      }

      // ngày
      if (/\b\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}(\/\d{2,4})?\b/.test(L) && !/\b(phuong|duong|xa)\b/.test(f)) { res.noteLines.push({ text: L, on: true }); return; }

      // địa chỉ (không nhãn)
      var rawLow = L.toLowerCase();
      if (ADDR_MARK.test(f) || /huyện|\bq\.\s?\d|\bp\.\s?\d/.test(rawLow)) { cust.addresses.push(L.replace(/[\s.,;]+$/, '')); res.skipped.push({ text: orig.trim(), why: 'Địa chỉ' }); return; }

      // ghi chú nhanh (chip)
      var chipHit = false, chipRest = f;
      if (/\b(khong|ko|k)\s+(dan\s+)?tem\b/.test(f)) { res.chips['Không tem'] = 1; chipHit = true; chipRest = chipRest.replace(/\b(khong|ko|k)\s+(dan\s+)?tem\b/g, ' '); }
      else if (/\btem\b/.test(f)) { res.chips['Có tem'] = 1; chipHit = true; chipRest = chipRest.replace(/\bdan\b/g, ' ').replace(/\btem\b/g, ' ').replace(/\bday du\b/g, ' '); }
      if (/\btui muong\b/.test(f)) { res.chips['Túi muỗng'] = 1; chipHit = true; chipRest = chipRest.replace(/\btui muong\b/g, ' '); }
      if (/\bcap dong\b/.test(f)) { res.chips['Cấp đông'] = 1; chipHit = true; chipRest = chipRest.replace(/\bcap dong\b/g, ' '); }
      if (/\bda bi\b/.test(f)) { res.chips['Thêm đá bi'] = 1; chipHit = true; chipRest = chipRest.replace(/\b(them )?da bi\b/g, ' '); }

      // dòng hàng?
